treks.overview:
Tsum Valley Trek | A Journey into Tibetan-Buddhist Culture & Himalayan Beauty

Tsum Valley, located in the northern Gorkha district of western Nepal, is a remote and culturally rich trekking destination within the Manaslu Conservation Area near the Tibetan border. Closed to foreigners until 2008 A.D., Tsum Valley offers a rare, untouched glimpse into ancient Tibetan Buddhist traditions, ancient monasteries like Mu Gompa and Rachen Gompa, and sacred caves where the 11th-century Buddhist yogi Milarepa once meditated.

This 17-day Tsum Valley Trek is the ultimate Buddhist cultural journey for travelers seeking peace, spiritual depth, and pristine mountain wilderness. Beyond the deep cultural immersion, you will enjoy spectacular mountain views of Ganesh Himal, Mount Manaslu, Himalchuli, Shringi Himal, and Boudha Himal during an excursion hike to Ganesh Himal Base Camp (4,200 m)—the highest point of the trip.

Trekking in Tsum Valley requires a Special Restricted Area Permit (RAP) and a Manaslu Conservation Area Permit (MCAP). A minimum of 2 trekkers accompanied by a licensed Nepali guide is required by government regulation. Zenex Travels & Tours handles all permit logistics, private transportation, teahouse arrangements, and guide services to ensure a seamless, unforgettable Himalayan adventure.
highlights: Experience breathtaking panoramic views of the Ganesh Himal range, Mt. Manaslu, Himalchuli, and Shringi Himal.
Trek through serene, uncrowded off-the-beaten-path trails inside the sacred Tsum Valley.
Explore ancient Tibetan-style Buddhist monasteries including Mu Gompa (3,700m) and Rachen Gompa.
Discover the historical caves where the famous 11th-century Buddhist yogi Milarepa meditated.
Day excursion hike to Ganesh Himal Base Camp (4,200m) for high-altitude mountain scenery.
Immerse in authentic Tibetan culture, stone mani walls, prayer flags, and local mountain hospitality.
Pass through pristine rhododendron forests, pine groves, alpine meadows, and cliffside trails.
Enjoy full logistics support, expert licensed guide, porters, and permit processing by Zenex Travels & Tours.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu
itinerary.desc: Upon arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) in Kathmandu, you will be met by a Zenex Travels representative and transferred to your hotel. We will hold a pre-trip briefing to review the itinerary, answer questions, and introduce your trekking guide. Overnight in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Trekking Preparation + Free Day / Kathmandu Sightseeing
itinerary.desc: Today our team processes your Special Restricted Area Permit with the Nepal Department of Immigration. You have a free day to explore UNESCO World Heritage sites in Kathmandu including Kathmandu Durbar Square, Swayambhunath (Monkey Temple), Boudhanath Stupa, and Pashupatinath Temple. Overnight in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Drive from Kathmandu to Machha Khola (870m)
itinerary.desc: After early breakfast, depart Kathmandu for a scenic 9-hour drive along the Prithvi Highway, passing Dhading, Arughat, and Soti Khola before arriving at Machha Khola. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Trek from Machha Khola to Jagat (1,340m)
itinerary.desc: The trail follows the Budhi Gandaki River through Gurung and Tamang villages, passing Khorlabesi, Tatopani natural hot springs, and suspension bridges up stone staircases to Jagat—the entry checkpoint for MCAP. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Trek from Jagat to Lokpa (2,240m) - Gateway to Tsum
itinerary.desc: After permit registration at Jagat, trek along the river gorge via Salleri and Philim. Branch off the main Manaslu Circuit trail at Nyak Phedi and climb steep trails to Lokpa—the official entry point of Tsum Valley. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Trek from Lokpa to Chumling (2,386m)
itinerary.desc: Descend into the Lungwa River valley through pine and rhododendron forests. Cross suspension bridges and climb steep rocky trails up to Chumling village, home to three ancient monasteries: Gurwa Gompa, Mani Dhumgyur, and Panago Gompa. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Trek from Chumling to Chokangparo (3,031m)
itinerary.desc: Enter Upper Tsum Valley, trekking past Tibetan-influenced villages to Rainjam and Gho. Ascend past yak pastures and stone chortens to Chokangparo (Chekampar), where flat terrace farms and traditional stone houses reflect authentic Tibetan heritage. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Trek from Chokangparo to Nile / Chule (3,361m) via Milarepa Cave
itinerary.desc: Trek up the valley to Lamagaun and visit the sacred Milarepa Cave where the 11th-century yogi meditated, leaving footprints in the rock. Continue past ancient stone murals to Chule and cross the Shiar Khola to Nile—the northernmost village in Upper Tsum. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Trek from Nile to Mu Gompa (3,700m)
itinerary.desc: A gradual 2-hour uphill trek leads to historic Mu Gompa (est. 1895), the highest and largest monastery in Tsum Valley, located near the Tibet border. Explore ancient Buddhist thangkas, life-size Avalokiteshwara statues, and sacred texts while interacting with local lamas. Overnight at monastery teahouse.

itinerary.title: Mu Gompa to Rechen Gompa (3,240m) & Lama Gaun (3,302m)
itinerary.desc: Descend past Phurbe village along the eastern bank of the Shiar Khola to Rechen Gompa (est. 1905), a nunnery showcasing vibrant Buddhist murals. Continue walking 30 minutes to Lama Gaun. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Trek from Rechen Gompa to Gumba Langdang (3,200m)
itinerary.desc: Descend to Gho for lunch, then cross the Shiar Khola bridge at Domje. Ascend through thick rhododendron and pine forests adorned with prayer flags up to Gumba Langdang, boasting incredible views of the Ganesh Himal range. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Excursion Hike to Ganesh Himal Base Camp (4,200m) & return
itinerary.desc: An exciting high-altitude day hike climbing through forests and alpine glacial moraines up to Ganesh Himal Base Camp (4,200m). Enjoy towering close-up vistas of Ganesh Himal peaks before descending back to Gumba Langdang. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Trek from Gumba Langdang back to Lokpa (2,240m)
itinerary.desc: Descend back through Domje, cross Ludang Khola, pass Ripche and Bhatti Ghumlong, and ascend back to Lokpa village. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Trek from Lokpa back to Jagat (1,340m)
itinerary.desc: Retrace your steps downhill past Philim and Sirdibas along the Budhi Gandaki River back to Jagat. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Trek from Jagat back to Machha Khola (870m)
itinerary.desc: Final day on the trekking trail walking past Tatopani hot springs and Khorlabesi to reach Machha Khola. Celebrate the trek completion with your guide and porter crew. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Drive from Machha Khola back to Kathmandu (1,350m)
itinerary.desc: Board your private vehicle for the drive back to Kathmandu. In the evening, join the Zenex Travels team for a traditional Nepali farewell dinner with cultural performances. Overnight at hotel.

itinerary.title: Departure from Kathmandu
itinerary.desc: Enjoy breakfast at your hotel. At the appointed time, our representative will transfer you to Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) for your return flight home.

treks.difficultyInfo: The Tsum Valley Trek is a MODERATE-level trek, suitable for people who are reasonably fit and enjoy walking for 5 to 7 hours a day on uneven mountain trails. It does not involve crossing extremely high altitude passes like Thorong La or Larkya La, but involves steady walking through pristine forests, suspension bridges, and remote monasteries. Highest point: Mu Gompa (3,700 m) & Ganesh Himal Base Camp (4,200 m). First-time Himalayan trekkers can safely complete this trek with proper preparation and licensed Zenex Travels guide support.

altitudeSickness.description: On the Manaslu Tsum Valley Trek, key high points like Mu Gompa (3,700 m) and Ganesh Himal Base Camp (4,200 m) require proper acclimatization, hydration, and pacing.
prevention: Walk slowly at your own pace; allow your body to adjust gradually to higher elevations.
Drink 3 to 4 liters of water daily, along with ginger tea & garlic soup.
Eat regular, carbohydrate-rich meals for sustained high-altitude energy.
Wear warm layers (head, chest, feet) and stay cozy in evenings.
Inform your Zenex Travels guide immediately if you experience headache, dizziness, or weakness.
Preventative medicines & remedies: Diamox (Acetazolamide) 1-2 days before ascending higher, plus Paracetamol or Ibuprofen for body aches.

extendedInfo.title: Permits Required for Tsum Valley Trek
extendedInfo.description: To complete the Tsum Valley Trek, you will need mandatory restricted area and conservation permits:
items: **Tsum Valley Restricted Area Permit (RAP):** Special restricted area permit mandatory for all foreign trekkers (minimum 2 trekkers + licensed Nepali guide required).
**Manaslu Conservation Area Permit (MCAP):** Required for entering the Manaslu Conservation Area covering the Tsum Valley trail.
**Full Logistics Handling:** Zenex Travels & Tours handles all permit applications and official immigration paperwork prior to departure.

extendedInfo.title: Best Time for Tsum Valley Trek in Nepal
extendedInfo.description: Tsum Valley can be trekked most times of the year, with Spring and Autumn offering prime mountain views and weather:
items: **Spring (March to May):** Warm temperatures, clear skies, blooming rhododendrons, and active mountain village farming.
**Autumn (Mid-September to November):** Crisp mountain vistas of Ganesh Himal and Manaslu, dry trails, and vibrant local Himalayan festivals (Dashain & Tihar).

extendedInfo.title: Meals & Accommodation during Tsum Valley Trek
extendedInfo.description: Stay in authentic teahouses and family-run lodges featuring simple twin-sharing rooms. High altitude points like Mu Gompa provide basic but warm shelter.

faqs.question: Where is the Tsum Valley Trek located?
faqs.answer: Tsum Valley is located in the northern Gorkha district of western Nepal, nestled inside the Manaslu Conservation Area near the Tibetan border.

faqs.question: What is Tsum Valley Trek popular for?
faqs.answer: It is famous for its untouched Tibetan Buddhist heritage, ancient monasteries (Mu Gompa & Rachen Gompa), Milarepa's meditation caves, and panoramic views of Ganesh Himal and Mt. Manaslu.

faqs.question: When is the best time to trek in Tsum Valley?
faqs.answer: Spring (March to May) and Autumn (September to November) offer clear mountain views, blooming rhododendrons, dry trails, and pleasant temperatures.

faqs.question: What permits are required for the Tsum Valley Trek?
faqs.answer: You require the Tsum Valley Special Restricted Area Permit (RAP) and the Manaslu Conservation Area Permit (MCAP). Zenex Travels & Tours processes all permits on your behalf.

faqs.question: Is a guide compulsory for Tsum Valley?
faqs.answer: Yes, as per Nepal government restricted area regulations, a minimum of 2 trekkers accompanied by a licensed Nepali guide is mandatory.

faqs.question: What kind of accommodation is available during the Tsum trek?
faqs.answer: Accommodation consists of clean, family-run mountain teahouses and lodges providing twin beds and warm communal dining halls.

faqs.question: Is food easily available on the route to Tsum Valley?
faqs.answer: Yes, teahouses prepare hot local meals including Dal Bhat, noodles, soups, fried rice, chapati, pancakes, and tea.

faqs.question: How difficult is the Tsum Valley Trek?
faqs.answer: It is graded as Moderate, suitable for anyone with reasonable physical fitness. The highest altitude point is 4,200m at Ganesh Himal Base Camp.

faqs.question: Is there mobile network or internet in Tsum Valley?
faqs.answer: Teahouses along lower trails offer basic Wi-Fi and solar charging for a small fee ($2-$5). Higher altitude areas may have limited connectivity.

faqs.question: Can I combine Tsum Valley with other treks?
faqs.answer: Yes! Tsum Valley can be seamlessly combined with the full Manaslu Circuit Trek or Annapurna Circuit.

treks.overview:
Langtang Valley Trek | Tamang Hospitality, Glaciers & Himalayan Peaks

Langtang Valley, situated just 123 km north of Kathmandu city, is often referred to as the "Valley of Glaciers". The 10-day Langtang Valley Trek is one of the most scenic and accessible short treks in Nepal, beginning and ending in Kathmandu with only a 6-hour drive to the trailhead at Syabrubesi.

Throughout this 10-day journey, travelers explore spectacular mountain panoramas of the Langtang Himalayan range, snow-capped peaks, lush pine and rhododendron forests, pristine alpine wilderness, and the rich native Tamang-Tibetan culture. The trail leads into Langtang National Park up to the sacred valley of Kyanjin Gompa (3,870 m), where options exist to ascend Kyanjin Ri (4,773 m) or Tserko Ri (4,985 m) for breathtaking views of Langtang Lirung Glacier and towering mountain giants.

Following the 2015 earthquake, Langtang village has been reborn with vibrant local spirit, featuring modern lodges, enhanced trails, and warm Tamang mountain hospitality. Zenex Travels & Tours arranges all permits, private transportation, teahouse accommodation, and expert guide services for a safe, memorable adventure.
highlights: Explore the beautiful Langtang Valley, famously known as the 'Valley of Glaciers'.
Trek through serene mountain trails, rivers, pine forests, and alpine wilderness.
Discover traditional Tamang villages and immerse in local mountain culture & hospitality.
Explore historic Tibetan Buddhist heritage, ancient monasteries, chortens, and Mani walls.
Observe herds of yaks grazing peacefully in alpine pastures.
Opportunity to see rare Himalayan wildlife & birds inside Langtang National Park.
Breathtaking 360-degree mountain views from Kyanjin Ri (4,773m) or Tserko Ri (4,985m).
Mind-blowing views of Mount Langtang Lirung (7,227m), Langtang Ri (6,370m), Yala Peak (5,500m), Ganjala Peak, and Dorje Lakpa (6,966m).
Stunning panoramas of Langtang Lirung Glacier, Dagpachen Glacier, and Yula Glacier.
No domestic flights required—accessible by a 6-hour drive from Kathmandu to Syabrubesi.
Enjoy lesser crowds and peaceful trails compared to Everest or Annapurna routes.
Full logistics support, expert licensed guide, porters, and permit processing by Zenex Travels & Tours.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu (1,350 m)
itinerary.desc: Upon arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) in Kathmandu, you will be greeted by a Zenex Travels representative and transferred to your hotel. We will hold a pre-trip briefing to review the trek itinerary, check equipment, and introduce your trekking guide. Overnight in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Drive from Kathmandu to Syabrubesi (1,503 m)
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, depart Kathmandu around 7-8 AM for a scenic 5-6 hour drive heading north through rolling green hills, passing Dunche to reach Syabrubesi (1,503 m)—the gateway town for the Langtang Valley Trek. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Trek from Syabrubesi to Lama Hotel (2,480 m)
itinerary.desc: Begin trekking by crossing the Bhote Koshi River and following the Langtang Khola. Hike gently uphill through dense oak, rhododendron, and bamboo forests inside Langtang National Park. Stop for lunch at Bamboo (1,960 m), climb up to Rimche (2,485 m), and continue 20 minutes to Lama Hotel. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Trek from Lama Hotel to Langtang Village (3,430 m)
itinerary.desc: Trek through lush rhododendron and oak forests up to Ghoratabela (3,030 m) for lunch while enjoying views of Langtang Lirung. Continue past Thyangsyap and Langtang Gompa to reach the beautifully rebuilt Langtang Village (3,430 m). Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Trek from Langtang Village to Kyanjin Gompa (3,870 m)
itinerary.desc: A shorter, gradual 3-hour trek walking past stone chortens, carved Mani walls, prayer flags, and yak pastures leading to Kyanjin Gompa (3,870 m). Explore the historic monastery and visit the famous Yala Cheese Factory established in 1952. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Kyanjin Gompa: Excursion Hike to Kyanjin Ri (4,773 m) or Tserko Ri (4,985 m)
itinerary.desc: Early morning sunrise hike up Kyanjin Ri (4,773 m) or Tserko Ri (4,985 m) for jaw-dropping 360-degree views of Langtang Lirung (7,227 m), Langtang Ri, Yala Peak, Dorje Lakpa, and surrounding glaciers. Return to Kyanjin Gompa for breakfast and rest. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Trek from Kyanjin Gompa back to Lama Hotel (2,480 m)
itinerary.desc: Bid farewell to Kyanjin Gompa and retrace your steps downhill along the Langtang River past Langtang Village and Ghoratabela for lunch, descending back to Lama Hotel. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Trek from Lama Hotel to Thulo Syabru (2,210 m)
itinerary.desc: Trek downhill past Rimche and Bamboo, then cross the river and ascend through green hills and terraced fields to Bhanjyang village. Enjoy stunning views of Ganesh Himal and Kerung Peak in Tibet before steeply descending to Thulo Syabru village. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Trek from Thulo Syabru to Dunche (1,960 m) & Drive back to Kathmandu (1,350 m)
itinerary.desc: Trek to Dunche town, board your private vehicle, and drive 5 hours back to Kathmandu. In the evening, join the Zenex Travels team for a traditional Nepali farewell dinner with cultural performances. Overnight at hotel.

itinerary.title: Departure from Kathmandu
itinerary.desc: Enjoy breakfast at your hotel. At your scheduled departure time, our representative will transfer you to Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) for your return flight home.

altitudeSickness.description: Acute Mountain Sickness (AMS) can occur above 3,500 meters. The highest sleeping point is Kyanjin Gompa (3,870 m), with optional day hikes to Kyanjin Ri (4,773 m) or Tserko Ri (4,985 m).
prevention: Ascend gradually with proper acclimatization pacing.
Drink at least 3–4 liters of water daily, along with ginger or garlic soups and herbal teas.
Eat carbohydrate-rich meals for sustained high-altitude energy.
Dress in warm layers to protect against cold and wind.
Inform your Zenex Travels guide immediately if you feel headache, nausea, or dizziness.
Medications & remedies: Diamox (Acetazolamide) 1-2 days before ascending higher, plus Ibuprofen or Paracetamol for headaches.

extendedInfo.title: Permits Required for Langtang Valley Trek
extendedInfo.description: To complete the Langtang Valley Trek, foreign travelers require the following mandatory permits:
items: **Langtang National Park Entrance Fee:** Required for entering the protected national park zone.
**TIMS Card (Trekkers' Information Management System):** Official registration card for safety tracking.
**Permit Handling:** Zenex Travels & Tours arranges all required permits and paperwork prior to departure.

extendedInfo.title: Best Time for Langtang Trek in Nepal
extendedInfo.description: Langtang Trek can be completed year-round, with peak seasons offering optimal weather:
items: **Spring (March to May):** Warm temperatures, clear skies, and vibrant blooming rhododendron forests.
**Autumn (September to November):** Stable weather, crisp air, and crystal-clear Himalayan mountain views.
**Winter (December to February):** Peaceful white snow-covered trails with fewer crowds (extra warm layers required).

faqs.question: Where is the Langtang Valley Trek located?
faqs.answer: Langtang Valley is located in the Rasuwa district of Nepal, inside Langtang National Park, just 123 km north of Kathmandu.

faqs.question: What is the maximum altitude of Langtang Trek?
faqs.answer: The highest sleeping point is Kyanjin Gompa (3,870 m), and the highest excursion point is Kyanjin Ri (4,773 m) or Tserko Ri (4,985 m).

faqs.question: How difficult is the Langtang Valley Trek?
faqs.answer: It is graded as an Easy to Moderate trek, suitable for beginners, families, and nature lovers with reasonable physical fitness.

faqs.question: What is the best time to do the Langtang Trek?
faqs.answer: Spring (March to May) and Autumn (September to November) offer clear skies, pleasant temperatures, and blooming rhododendrons.

faqs.question: What permits are required for Langtang Trek?
faqs.answer: You need the Langtang National Park Permit and the TIMS card. Zenex Travels & Tours handles all permit processing.

faqs.question: Is a guide mandatory for Langtang Valley Trek?
faqs.answer: While solo trekking with a porter is possible, hiring a licensed guide from Zenex Travels is strongly recommended for safety, navigation, and local cultural insights.

faqs.question: What accommodation is available on the Langtang Trek?
faqs.answer: Clean, family-run mountain teahouses and lodges offering twin-sharing rooms, warm blankets, and communal heated dining rooms.

faqs.question: What is the temperature during Langtang Trek?
faqs.answer: Daytime temperatures in Spring/Autumn range from 10°C to 20°C in lower trails, dropping to 0°C to -5°C at night at Kyanjin Gompa.

faqs.question: What mountains can you see during the Langtang Trek?
faqs.answer: You can view Mount Langtang Lirung (7,227m), Langtang Ri (6,370m), Yala Peak (5,500m), Dorje Lakpa (6,966m), and Ganesh Himal.

faqs.question: Is Langtang Trek suitable for beginners and families?
faqs.answer: Yes! With gradual elevation gain, well-maintained trails, and a 6-hour drive from Kathmandu, it is ideal for beginners, kids, and seniors.

faqs.question: What makes Langtang Valley Trek special?
faqs.answer: It combines glacier panoramas, rich Tamang-Tibetan culture, ancient monasteries, herds of yaks, and inspiring community resilience after the 2015 earthquake.

faqs.question: Can Langtang trekking be done in 5 days?
faqs.answer: Yes, a shortened 5-day or 7-day version focusing purely on the core Syabrubesi to Kyanjin Gompa trail can be customized upon request.

treks.title: Helambu & Langtang Trek - 17 Days
treks.location: Langtang National Park & Helambu, Rasuwa / Sindhupalchok, Nepal
treks.accommodation: 3-Star Hotel in Kathmandu / Mountain Lodges on Trail
treks.meals: Breakfast in Kathmandu, All Meals (Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner) on Trek
treks.overview:
Helambu & Langtang Trek | Sacred Alpine Lakes, Lauribina Pass & Glacial Peaks

The 17-Day Helambu & Langtang Valley Trek in the Langtang region of Nepal is a grand Himalayan journey combining the culturally rich Hyolmo-Sherpa villages of Helambu, the sacred high-altitude Gosaikunda Lakes, and the glacial vistas of Langtang Valley. By connecting the Helambu Circuit Trek with the Langtang Valley Trek via Lauribina Pass (4,610 m), trekkers experience one of Nepal's most complete and rewarding off-the-beaten-path adventures.

Beginning with a scenic drive from Kathmandu to Melamchi Bazar, the trail climbs through tranquil forests, terraced fields, and ancient Buddhist villages including Kakani, Tarke Ghyang, and Sermathang. Crossing the high Lauribina Pass brings you to the sacred turquoise waters of Gosaikunda Lake (4,380 m)—a revered pilgrimage site for both Hindus (abode of Lord Shiva) and Buddhists (dwelling place of Chenrezig). Continuing past Shin Gompa and Thulo Syabru, the route enters Langtang National Park, leading up to Kyanjin Gompa (3,870 m) with optional ascents to Kyanjin Ri (4,773 m) or Tserko Ri (4,985 m) for breathtaking 360-degree views of Langtang Lirung (7,227 m), Dorje Lakpa, Ganesh Himal, and Manaslu.

At Zenex Travels & Tours, we handle every detail—from permit processing (Langtang National Park & TIMS) to private ground transfers, licensed professional guide and porter services, teahouse reservations, and personalized itinerary support—ensuring a smooth, safe, and soulful Himalayan experience.
highlights: Explore two culturally rich regions—Helambu and Langtang—known for serene villages, Tibetan Buddhist heritage, and warm hospitality.
Begin your journey from the peaceful villages of Kakani and Tarke Ghyang, passing through traditional Sherpa and Tamang communities.
Cross the scenic Lauribina Pass (4,610 m) and visit the sacred alpine lakes of Gosaikunda, a major pilgrimage site.
Trek through Langtang National Park, home to diverse flora, fauna, and chances to spot red pandas, Himalayan thars, and langurs.
Visit ancient monasteries such as Kyanjin Gompa and Sermathang, staying in spiritual villages influenced by Tibetan Buddhism.
Reach Kyanjin Gompa (3,870 m) and optionally ascend Kyanjin Ri (4,773 m) or Tserko Ri (4,985 m) for panoramas of Langtang Lirung & Ganesh Himal.
Enjoy varied landscapes—from lush rhododendron and pine forests to rugged high-altitude terrain, glacial valleys, and snow-capped mountains.
Discover a peaceful, off-the-beaten-path trekking experience with fewer crowds compared to Everest and Annapurna regions.
Taste authentic local food and learn about the traditional lifestyle of mountain communities.
A perfect mix of nature, spirituality, and soft adventure, ideal for trekkers looking for cultural depth and scenic Himalayan beauty.

quickFacts.accommodation: 3-Star Hotel in Kathmandu / Teahouses on Trail

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu
itinerary.highlights: Airport transfer, pre-trip briefing, guide meeting, equipment check.
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) in Kathmandu, you will be greeted by our correspondent from Zenex Travels & Tours who will assist with your hotel transfer. Checked in, we arrange a pre-trip meeting to brief you on the trek, answer questions, and introduce your trekking guide. Rest and relax at leisure. Overnight at hotel.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu – Melamchi Bazar – Kakani
itinerary.highlights: Drive to Melamchi Bazar, uphill hike through Tamang & Sherpa villages, views of Gaurishankar.
itinerary.description: After breakfast in Kathmandu, your guide meets you to begin driving toward Melamchi Bazar (870 m), taking about 4 hours. After lunch at Melamchi Bazar, prepare to trek uphill toward Kakani for about 2 hours. Pass several ethnic villages of Tamang, Sherpa, Chhetri, and Brahmin communities with stunning vistas of Langtang and Gaurishankar ranges. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Kakani – Tarke Ghyang
itinerary.highlights: Gentle uphill through forests, lunch at Sermathang Sherpa village, ancient monasteries.
itinerary.description: Begin trekking toward Tarke Ghyang with a gentle uphill walk through lush forests, terraced fields, and charming Sherpa settlements. Stop at Sermathang, a traditional Sherpa village famous for its ancient monastery and community life, for lunch. Continue hiking toward Tarke Ghyang—one of the oldest Sherpa villages in Helambu offering serene Buddhist heritage. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Tarke Ghyang – Melamchi Gaun
itinerary.highlights: Undulating forest trail, prayer flags, Buddhist monasteries, authentic rural life.
itinerary.description: Trek through a scenic trial filled with up-and-down sections across dense forests, terraced farmlands, and hillside settlements. Enjoy views of traditional homes, prayer flags, and verdant hills. Arrive in Melamchi Gaun, a vibrant Tamang and Sherpa village renowned for its monastery and warm mountain hospitality. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Melamchi Gaun – Tharepati
itinerary.highlights: Steady ascent through rhododendron & oak forests, ridge viewpoint of Manaslu & Ganesh Himal.
itinerary.description: Ascend steadily through dense rhododendron and oak forests, gaining altitude as lower hills fall behind. As trees thin out, panoramic views of Langtang, Ganesh Himal, Manaslu, and Gaurishankar open up. Reach Tharepati on an open ridge by lunchtime—a major junction offering one of the finest viewpoints on the trail. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Tharepati – Phedi
itinerary.highlights: Alpine terrain walk, rugged mountain ridges, preparation for Lauribina Pass.
itinerary.description: Embark on a long, gradual trek through alpine terrain as you approach Lauribina Pass. Climb through rhododendron and juniper bushes before entering the treeless high-altitude zone. Expect rocky ridges and thinning air with dramatic views of Langtang and Manaslu ranges. Arrive in Phedi ('foot of the pass') to rest and acclimatize before tomorrow's pass crossing. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Phedi – Lauribina Pass (4,610 m) – Gosaikunda
itinerary.highlights: Cross Lauribina Pass (4610m), stunning high altitude views, arrival at sacred Gosaikunda Lake.
itinerary.description: Start early with a steep 2-hour ascent to Lauribina Pass (4,610 m), the highest pass of the trek. Enjoy breathtaking panoramas of Langtang Lirung, Ganesh Himal, Manaslu, Dorje Lakpa, and Tibetan peaks. Descend gradually through rocky terrain for 2.5 hours to reach sacred Gosaikunda Lake (4,380 m)—a pristine alpine pilgrimage site for Hindus and Buddhists. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Gosaikunda – Shin Gompa – Thulo Syabru
itinerary.highlights: Descent through Shin Gompa yak cheese center, pine & rhododendron forests to Thulo Syabru.
itinerary.description: Complete the Helambu circuit leg by descending from Gosaikunda to Shin Gompa (3,330 m) in about 3 hours, taking in continuous views of Langtang and Ganesh Himal. After resting at Shin Gompa (famous for its local monastery and yak cheese factory), continue descending 3 hours through pine forests into Thulo Syabru (2,210 m), a scenic Tamang village. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Thulo Syabru – Lama Hotel
itinerary.highlights: Cross Ghopche Khola suspension bridge, spot wildlife (monkeys, red pandas), reach Lama Hotel.
itinerary.description: Transition into the core Langtang Valley trail. Descend steeply to cross Ghopche Khola through subtropical forests rich with wildlife including langurs, red pandas, and rare birds. Ascend past Bamboo and Rimche to reach the serene forest village of Lama Hotel along the Langtang Khola. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Lama Hotel – Langtang Village
itinerary.highlights: Trail through Ghodatabela, waterfalls, Tamang settlements, view of Langtang Lirung.
itinerary.description: Trek through oak and rhododendron forests toward Ghodatabela (3,030 m) for lunch or rest. Continue past Thyangsyap, Chayamki, and Langtang Gompa to reach Langtang Village (3,430 m). Witness the inspiring rebuilding of the village after the 2015 earthquake, set beneath towering peaks of Langtang Lirung and Ganesh Himal. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Langtang – Kyanjin Gompa
itinerary.highlights: Shorter trek past Mani walls & chortens, visit Kyanjin Gompa monastery & Swiss cheese factory.
itinerary.description: Enjoy a shorter 3-hour trek winding past chortens, prayer flags, Mani walls, and grazing yaks. Arrive in Kyanjin Gompa (3,870 m), the spiritual heart of Langtang Valley. Visit the historic Kyanjin Monastery and the famous Yala Cheese Factory established in 1952 with Swiss support. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Kyanjin Gompa | Ascend Kyanjin Ri (4,773 m) or Tserko Ri (4,985 m)
itinerary.highlights: Sunrise peak climb to Kyanjin Ri or Tserko Ri, 360-degree glacier panoramas of Langtang range.
itinerary.description: Hike early morning to Kyanjin Ri (4,773 m) in 2.5 hours for an unforgettable sunrise over Langtang Lirung (7,245 m), Langtang Ri (6,370 m), Yala Peak (5,520 m), and Dorje Lakpa (6,966 m). Return for breakfast and optional further excursion up Tserko Ri (4,985 m) for ultimate Himalayan panoramas. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Kyanjin Gompa – Lama Hotel
itinerary.highlights: Descend back through Ghodatabela, enjoy lush forest scenery and rivers.
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to Kyanjin Gompa and retrace your steps downhill through Langtang Village and Ghodatabela for lunch. Continue descending back to Lama Hotel alongside the roaring Langtang Khola. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Lama Hotel – Syabrubesi
itinerary.highlights: Final trek day along Langtang Khola through bamboo & pine forests to Syabrubesi.
itinerary.description: Trek the final leg of the trail down to Syabrubesi (1,503 m), descending through pine and bamboo groves with chances to see langurs and colorful mountain birds. Celebrate the successful trek completion with your guide and porters. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Syabrubesi – Kathmandu
itinerary.highlights: Scenic drive through Trishuli valley back to Kathmandu city hotel.
itinerary.description: After breakfast in Syabrubesi, drive back to Kathmandu in a private vehicle (approx. 6 hours). Check into your hotel and spend the evening unwinding or celebrating your mountain achievement. Overnight at hotel.

itinerary.title: Free day in Kathmandu
itinerary.highlights: Optional UNESCO heritage tour (Swoyambhunath, Boudhanath, Pashupatinath), shopping, farewell dinner.
itinerary.description: Free day in Kathmandu for relaxing, spa/massage, souvenir shopping in Thamel, or visiting UNESCO World Heritage sites such as Swoyambhunath (Monkey Temple), Boudhanath Stupa, and Pashupatinath. In the evening, enjoy an official farewell dinner hosted by Zenex Travels & Tours. Overnight at hotel.

itinerary.title: Departure from Kathmandu
itinerary.highlights: Airport transfer for international departure flight.
itinerary.description: Enjoy your final morning in Kathmandu. At your scheduled departure time, our Zenex Travels representative will pick you up from the hotel and transfer you to Tribhuvan International Airport for your flight home.

It involves steady ascents, forest trails, and high altitude pass crossing at Lauribina Pass (4,610 m) and viewpoints like Kyanjin Ri (4,773 m) or Tserko Ri (4,985 m). Daily walking averages 5 to 7 hours. Suitable for trekkers with basic physical fitness.

altitudeSickness.description: Altitude sickness can occur above 3,000 meters. Our itinerary is carefully designed with gradual elevation gain for proper acclimatization.
prevention: Follow the gradual elevation gain built into the 17-day itinerary.
Drink at least 3-4 liters of clean water daily to stay hydrated.
Avoid alcohol, smoking, and sleeping pills at high altitudes.
Inform your Zenex Travels guide immediately if you experience headaches or nausea.

extendedInfo.title: Lauribina Pass (4,610 m) – High Point of Helambu & Langtang Trek
extendedInfo.description: Lauribina Pass (4,610 m) connects the scenic Buddhist hills of Helambu with the sacred alpine Gosaikunda lakes and Langtang National Park. In local dialect, 'Lauri' means staff and 'bina' means without. Legend says only those walking with pure spirit cross without reliance on a staff. Reaching the pass rewards trekkers with breathtaking views of Langtang Lirung, Manaslu, and Ganesh Himal.

extendedInfo.title: Gosaikunda Lake – Sacred Alpine Sanctuary
extendedInfo.description: Gosaikunda Lake is a sacred high-altitude alpine lake nestled at 4,380 meters inside Langtang National Park. In Hindu belief, Lord Shiva created the lake by striking his trident (Trishul) into the mountain to release cooling water after consuming poison. In Tibetan Buddhist tradition, Gosaikunda is revered as the dwelling place of Avalokiteshvara (Chenrezig)—the Bodhisattva of Compassion.

extendedInfo.title: Why Choose Zenex Travels & Tours for Helambu & Langtang Trekking?
extendedInfo.description: Zenex Travels & Tours brings over two decades of expert Himalayan trekking logistics. We handle all park entry permits, TIMS registration, private vehicular transfers, verified teahouse reservations, and certified English-speaking guides and porters to ensure your 17-day journey is safe, authentic, and unforgettable.

extendedInfo.title: Required Permits
extendedInfo.description: Trekkers require the Langtang National Park Entry Permit and TIMS (Trekker's Information Management System) Card. Zenex Travels & Tours prepares and processes all permit documentation in advance.

extendedInfo.title: Meals & Accommodations on Trail

faqs.question: Where is the Helambu & Langtang Trek located?
faqs.answer: The trek is located in the Langtang Region of Nepal, spanning Helambu (Sindhupalchok) and Langtang National Park (Rasuwa), just northeast of Kathmandu.

faqs.question: What is the maximum altitude reached on this trek?
faqs.answer: The maximum pass altitude is Lauribina Pass at 4,610 m, with optional excursion peak climbs to Kyanjin Ri (4,773 m) or Tserko Ri (4,985 m).

faqs.question: How difficult is the Helambu & Langtang 17-Day Trek?
faqs.answer: It is rated Moderate. While trails are well-established, it requires walking 5-7 hours daily and crossing a high pass (4,610 m), suitable for fit beginners and experienced hikers.

faqs.question: What is the best season for this trek?
faqs.answer: Spring (March to May) for blooming rhododendrons and pleasant weather, and Autumn (September to November) for crystal clear mountain visibility.

faqs.question: What permits are required for Helambu & Langtang Trek?
faqs.answer: You need the Langtang National Park Entry Permit and TIMS Card. Zenex Travels & Tours handles all permit logistics.

faqs.question: Is a guide mandatory for this trek?
faqs.answer: Yes, hiring a licensed Nepali guide from Zenex Travels & Tours is required for safety, navigation across high passes, and local cultural interaction.

faqs.question: What style of accommodation is provided during the trek?
faqs.answer: Comfortable teahouses and mountain lodges with twin-sharing beds, warm blankets, and heated dining areas.

faqs.question: What temperatures can be expected during the trek?
faqs.answer: Spring and Autumn daytime temperatures range between 10°C and 18°C in lower trails, dropping to 0°C to -5°C at higher elevations like Gosaikunda and Kyanjin Gompa.

faqs.question: What mountains can be seen on the Helambu & Langtang Trek?
faqs.answer: Panoramas include Langtang Lirung (7,227m), Ganesh Himal, Mt. Manaslu, Dorje Lakpa (6,966m), Langtang Ri, and Gaurishankar.

faqs.question: Is this trek suitable for beginners?
faqs.answer: Yes, active beginners with good health and basic hiking preparation can complete this 17-day trek successfully with our gradual acclimatization itinerary.

faqs.question: What makes combining Helambu and Langtang special?
faqs.answer: It blends two distinct regions into one journey: the peaceful Hyolmo-Sherpa cultural villages of Helambu, the sacred lakes of Gosaikunda, and the dramatic glacier valley of Langtang.

treks.overview:
Ruby Valley Trek | Untouched Wilderness & Homestay Trails Between Langtang & Manaslu

The 12-Day Ruby Valley Trek is a hidden gem tucked into the Ganesh Himal region of central Nepal, nestled serenely between the Langtang Valley to the east and the Manaslu region to the west. Named after the precious gem mines hidden in the surrounding mountains, the Ruby Valley offers a quiet, crowd-free alternative to Nepal's mainstream trekking routes.

Throughout this 12-day journey, trekkers are treated to spectacular mountain views of Ganesh Himal, Langtang Lirung, Mt. Manaslu, and Annapurna. The trail climbs through dense rhododendron and pine forests, peaceful valleys, and alpine pastures, crossing high suspension bridges and the panoramic Pangsang Pass (3,850 m)—the highest point of the trek. A major highlight is authentic cultural immersion: staying in local homestays with Tamang, Gurung, and Dalit villagers, relaxing in natural hot springs at Shertung, and visiting ancient Buddhist monasteries and Mani walls.

At Zenex Travels & Tours, we manage all trek details—including Langtang National Park entry permits, ground transportation, certified English-speaking guides and porters, homestay bookings, and gear support—ensuring a memorable, safe, and culturally rich Himalayan experience.
highlights: Explore a quiet, crowd-free off-the-beaten-path trekking trail in the Ganesh Himal region.
Enjoy breathtaking views of Ganesh Himal, Langtang Lirung, Mt. Manaslu, and Annapurna peaks.
Cross the scenic Pangsang Pass (3,850 m), offering panoramic 360-degree Himalayan vistas.
Experience authentic Tamang and Gurung homestays, warm hospitality, and traditional local cuisine.
Relax in natural hot springs near Shertung village after trekking days.
Discover ancient Buddhist monasteries, chortens, prayer flags, and historic copper mines near Somdang.
Trek through blooming rhododendron, bamboo, and pine forests with chances to spot langurs and musk deer.
Support sustainable community-based tourism directly benefiting local mountain villages.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu
itinerary.highlights: Airport arrival transfer, pre-trip briefing, equipment check.
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) in Kathmandu, our Zenex Travels representative will pick you up in a private vehicle and transfer you to your hotel. After check-in, we host a pre-trip briefing, meet your trekking guide, and prepare gear for the upcoming journey. Overnight at hotel.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu – Syabrubesi
itinerary.highlights: Scenic drive through hills and along the Trishuli River to the gateway of Langtang.
itinerary.description: Depart Kathmandu early morning around 7-8 AM, driving north through scenic hills, terraced farmlands, and mountain towns like Dhunche. Arrive in Syabrubesi (1,503 m), a bustling town nestled along the Trishuli River inside Langtang National Park. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Syabrubesi – Gatlang
itinerary.highlights: Steady ascent through Tamang settlements with views of Ganesh Himal & stone houses of Gatlang.
itinerary.description: Begin trekking with a steady 2.5-hour uphill climb through forested hills and traditional Tamang villages. Enjoy sweeping views of Ganesh Himal and the Langtang range. Arrive in Gatlang (2,238 m), a charming cultural village renowned for its distinctive stone houses and Tamang heritage. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Gatlang – Somdang
itinerary.highlights: Visit sacred Parvati Kunda lake, walk through bamboo/rhododendron forests & old copper mines.
itinerary.description: Trek through terraced fields and pine forests, passing the sacred Parvati Kunda lake where locals perform rituals. The trail grows steeper and more secluded through dense rhododendron and bamboo woods, passing abandoned copper mines before reaching the quiet valley of Somdang (3,270 m). Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Somdang – Pangsang Pass (3,850 m) – Tipling
itinerary.highlights: Climb to Pangsang Pass (3850m) for 360-degree views of Ganesh Himal, Manaslu & Annapurna.
itinerary.description: A highlight day! Ascend gradually from Somdang to Pangsang Pass (3,850 m), the highest point of the trek. Be rewarded with breathtaking panoramas of Ganesh Himal, Langtang Lirung, Manaslu, and Annapurna. After enjoying the pass, descend through forests and streams into Tipling (1,890 m), a vibrant Tamang village. Overnight at teahouse/homestay.

itinerary.title: Tipling – Shertung
itinerary.highlights: Short scenic walk through farmlands & terraced hills to Shertung ('Place of Gold').
itinerary.description: Enjoy a lighter 3 to 4 hour trek descending through terraced fields, pine groves, and traditional settlements. Arrive in Shertung (1,920 m), meaning 'Place of Gold', inhabited by Tamang and Gurung communities. Spend the afternoon exploring local monasteries or relaxing. Overnight at homestay/lodge.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization & Exploration Day at Shertung | Chalish Gaun & Hot Springs
itinerary.highlights: Explore Chalish Gaun village, soak in natural hot springs, experience local culture.
itinerary.description: A rest and acclimatization day. In the afternoon, take a relaxed 3-hour walk to Chalish Gaun, a picturesque Tamang village with stone houses and friendly locals. Soak in the nearby natural hot springs to soothe muscles before returning to Shertung for the night. Overnight at homestay/lodge.

itinerary.title: Shertung – Lapa Gaun
itinerary.highlights: Comfortable walk through rhododendron forests, valley vistas, peaceful rural life.
itinerary.description: Trek along a gentle downhill and flat path through lush rhododendron and pine forests. Enjoy serene views of valley hillsides and farmlands while observing local wildlife and bird species. Arrive in the peaceful village of Lapa Gaun (1,850 m). Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Lapa Gaun – Jharlang
itinerary.highlights: Scenic trail across terraced farmlands, traditional Tamang & Gurung hamlets.
itinerary.description: Walk across terraced fields, forest trails, and small traditional hamlets toward Jharlang (3,000 m). The gentle, well-marked path offers authentic interactions with local villagers and peaceful nature views. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Jharlang – Darkha Gaun (850 m) [Trek] – Dhading Besi (580 m)
itinerary.highlights: Final trek down to Darkha Gaun, scenic drive to lowland town of Dhading Besi.
itinerary.description: Hike downhill from Jharlang to Darkha Gaun (850 m) in about 4-5 hours, passing through lush green hills and farmland. Meet your private vehicle at Darkha Gaun for a scenic drive to Dhading Besi (580 m). Overnight at hotel.

itinerary.title: Dhading Besi – Kathmandu
itinerary.highlights: Return drive along Trishuli river valley to Kathmandu, leisure evening in Thamel.
itinerary.description: Drive back to Kathmandu (approx. 5-6 hours) through river valleys and rural villages. Check into your city hotel, relax, explore Thamel markets, or enjoy a celebratory dinner. Overnight at hotel.

itinerary.title: Departure from Kathmandu
itinerary.highlights: Airport transfer for departure flight.
itinerary.description: Enjoy your final breakfast in Kathmandu. Our representative from Zenex Travels & Tours will pick you up from your hotel and transfer you to Tribhuvan International Airport for your departure flight.

faqs.question: Where is the Ruby Valley Trek located?
faqs.answer: Ruby Valley is located in central Nepal within the Ganesh Himal region between Langtang National Park and Manaslu.

faqs.question: What is the maximum altitude of the Ruby Valley Trek?
faqs.answer: The highest point is Pangsang Pass at 3,850 meters (12,631 ft).

faqs.question: What is the best time to do the Ruby Valley Trek?
faqs.answer: Spring (March to May) for blooming rhododendrons and Autumn (September to November) for clear skies and mountain visibility.

faqs.question: What kind of accommodation is available on the Ruby Valley Trek?

faqs.question: What mountains can you see on the Ruby Valley Trek?

faqs.question: Are there hot springs on the Ruby Valley trail?

treks.overview:
Tamang Heritage and Langtang Valley Trek | Cultural Homestays, Hot Springs & Glacial Peaks

The 15-Day Tamang Heritage and Langtang Valley Trek offers a unique blend of cultural immersion and stunning Himalayan wilderness in Nepal’s Rasuwa district. Combining the traditional Tamang Heritage Trail with the alpine beauty of Langtang Valley, this moderate-grade trek takes you through ancient stone villages, sacred monasteries, and natural hot springs before ascending into high-altitude glacial terrain.

Along the initial cultural trail, trekkers visit Gatlang, Tatopani (famous for natural healing hot springs), Nagthali viewpoint (3,165 m), Thuman, and Briddhim homestay village. You'll experience warm Tamang-Tibetan hospitality, traditional dances, and ancient craft traditions. Joining the main Langtang route past Lama Hotel and Langtang Village, the trail reaches Kyanjin Gompa (3,870 m) where optional ascents to Kyanjin Ri (4,773 m) or Tserko Ri (4,985 m) afford breathtaking 360-degree panoramas of Langtang Lirung (7,227 m), Dorje Lakpa, and Ganesh Himal.

At Zenex Travels & Tours, we manage all logistics—including Langtang National Park entry permits, TIMS registration, private vehicle transfers, certified English-speaking guides and porters, homestay bookings, and gear support—ensuring a seamless, safe, and deeply rewarding Himalayan adventure.
highlights: Explore the vibrant culture, traditions, and festivals of indigenous Tamang communities.
Visit Tatopani's natural hot springs and ancient Buddhist monasteries like Kyanjin Gompa.
Trek through Langtang National Park, home to rare wildlife like red pandas and Himalayan thars.
Enjoy panoramic views of Langtang Lirung (7,227 m), Ganesh Himal, Dorje Lakpa, and Tibetan peaks.
Climb to Nagthali viewpoint (3,165 m), a historic meditation retreat site with 360-degree mountain vistas.
Stay in community-based homestays in Briddhim and authentic mountain teahouses along the trail.
Experience serene rhododendron, pine, and bamboo forests with cascading waterfalls and river bridges.
Enjoy a quiet, off-the-beaten-path cultural trek with moderate physical challenge suitable for all hikers.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu
itinerary.highlights: Airport transfer, pre-trip briefing, guide meeting, gear preparation.
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) in Kathmandu, you will be greeted by our Zenex Travels representative who will assist with your hotel transfer. After check-in, we host a pre-trip briefing, answer questions, and introduce your trekking guide. Overnight at hotel.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu – Syabrubesi
itinerary.highlights: Drive along Trishuli River valley to the gateway town of Langtang National Park.
itinerary.description: Depart Kathmandu around 7-8 AM, driving north through winding mountain roads, terraced farmlands, and mountain towns like Dhunche. Arrive in Syabrubesi (1,503 m), located along the banks of the Trishuli River inside Langtang National Park. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Syabrubesi – Gatlang
itinerary.highlights: Uphill trek through Tamang hamlets, view of Ganesh Himal, stone-built houses of Gatlang.
itinerary.description: Trek uphill for 2.5 hours through forested hills and Tamang settlements. Enjoy views of Ganesh Himal and Langtang ranges. Reach Gatlang (2,238 m), a traditional Tamang village famous for stone houses, chortens, and warm mountain hospitality. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Gatlang – Tatopani
itinerary.highlights: Descend to Thangbuche river bridge, steady climb to Tatopani natural hot springs.
itinerary.description: Descend to Thangbuche, cross a suspension bridge, and climb steadily through terraced fields and forested ridges. Enjoy views of Ganesh Himal. Arrive in Tatopani (2,607 m), famous for its natural hot springs believed to have healing properties. Relax in the hot springs. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Tatopani – Nagthali (3,165 m) – Thuman
itinerary.highlights: Climb to Nagthali viewpoint for panoramas of Ganesh Himal & Tibetan peaks, descend to Thuman.
itinerary.description: Ascend 2.5 hours to Nagthali (3,165 m), a high ridge viewpoint once used as a meditation retreat for Tibetan monks. Enjoy 360-degree views of Paldor Peak, Ganesh Himal, and Langtang Lirung. Descend through rhododendron forests to Thuman (2,338 m), a village rich in Tibetan-influenced Tamang culture. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Thuman – Briddhim
itinerary.highlights: Cross Bhote Koshi River, walk through corn fields, stay in Briddhim community homestay.
itinerary.description: Trek along a narrow trail through forests and corn fields, crossing the Bhote Koshi River via suspension bridge. Climb to Briddhim (2,229 m), a peaceful village on the lap of Langtang Himal known for community-based homestays, old monasteries, and Tamang hospitality. Overnight at lodge/homestay.

itinerary.title: Briddhim – Lama Hotel
itinerary.highlights: Connect with the main Langtang Valley trail, walk along Langtang Khola river to Lama Hotel.
itinerary.description: Descend gently through pine and rhododendron woods before ascending along the roaring Langtang Khola. Pass small settlements and spot langur monkeys and birdlife before reaching Lama Hotel (2,480 m), nestled in the forest. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Lama Hotel – Langtang Village
itinerary.highlights: Trek through Ghodatabela & Thyangsyap, view waterfalls and towering Langtang Lirung.
itinerary.description: Walk through oak and rhododendron forests to Ghodatabela (3,030 m) for rest or lunch. Continue past Thyangsyap and Chayamki to reach Langtang Village (3,430 m). Marvel at the inspiring village resilience following the 2015 earthquake under the shadow of Langtang Lirung. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Langtang – Kyanjin Gompa
itinerary.highlights: Short scenic hike past Mani walls & chortens, visit Kyanjin Gompa & Yala Cheese Factory.
itinerary.description: Enjoy a short 3-hour trek past chortens, prayer flags, and yak pastures to Kyanjin Gompa (3,870 m). Visit the ancient monastery and the historic Yala Cheese Factory established in 1952 with Swiss assistance. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Kyanjin Gompa | Ascend Kyanjin Ri (4,773 m) or Tserko Ri (4,985 m)
itinerary.highlights: Early sunrise climb to Kyanjin Ri or Tserko Ri, 360-degree glacier panoramas.
itinerary.description: Hike early morning to Kyanjin Ri (4,773 m) for sunrise over Langtang Lirung (7,245 m), Langtang Ri (6,370 m), Yala Peak (5,520 m), and Dorje Lakpa (6,966 m). Return for breakfast and optional hike up Tserko Ri (4,985 m) for ultimate glacier views. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Kyanjin Gompa – Lama Hotel
itinerary.highlights: Descend back through Ghodatabela along the Langtang Khola.
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to Kyanjin Gompa and trek downhill through Langtang Village and Ghodatabela for lunch. Continue descending back to Lama Hotel. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Lama Hotel – Thulo Syabru
itinerary.highlights: Trek via Sherpagaon & Bhanjyang, view Kerung Peak (Tibet) & Ganesh Himal.
itinerary.description: Trek along easy trails through terraced fields to Sherpagaon (2,500 m). Continue up and down to Bhanjyang village for panoramic views of Ganesh Himal and Kerung Peak in Tibet, then descend steeply into Thulo Syabru (2,210 m). Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Thulo Syabru – Dhunche – Kathmandu
itinerary.highlights: Walk to Dhunche, scenic drive back to Kathmandu city hotel.
itinerary.description: Trek to Dhunche (1,960 m) to complete your trail journey. Meet your private vehicle for a 5-hour drive back to Kathmandu. Check into your hotel and relax. Overnight at hotel.

itinerary.title: Free day in Kathmandu
itinerary.highlights: Relaxation, souvenir shopping in Thamel, official farewell dinner.
itinerary.description: Enjoy a free day in Kathmandu for shopping, visiting UNESCO sites like Swoyambhunath and Boudhanath, or relaxing. In the evening, join your guide for a traditional farewell dinner hosted by Zenex Travels & Tours. Overnight at hotel.

itinerary.title: Departure from Kathmandu
itinerary.highlights: Airport transfer for departure flight.
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast at your hotel. At your scheduled departure time, our Zenex Travels representative will transfer you to Tribhuvan International Airport for your flight home.

treks.overview:
Tamang Heritage Trek | Authentic Village Homestays, Hot Springs & Himalayan Roots

The 10-Day Tamang Heritage Trek in Nepal's Langtang region is a peaceful, culturally rich short journey through traditional Tamang villages, forested hills, and scenic mountain landscapes. Tucked close to the Tibetan border, this trail immerses trekkers in centuries-old Tamang Buddhist traditions, warm family homestays, ancient monasteries, traditional weaving crafts, and vibrant local festivals.

Starting with a scenic drive from Kathmandu to Syabrubesi, the trail loops through traditional villages including Gatlang (renowned for stone-built houses), Tatopani (famous for natural healing thermal hot springs), Nagthali viewpoint (3,165 m)—a historic meditation ridge offering 360-degree views of Ganesh Himal and Langtang Lirung—Thuman, and Briddhim homestay village. Graded as an Easy trek with a manageable maximum altitude of 3,165 meters, it is ideal for beginners, families, and culture seekers.

At Zenex Travels & Tours, we manage all logistics—including Langtang National Park entry permits, TIMS registration, private vehicle transfers, certified English-speaking guides and porters, homestay bookings, and gear support—ensuring a smooth, safe, and soulful Himalayan experience.
highlights: Experience stunning views of the Langtang Lirung and Ganesh Himal ranges throughout the trail.
Enjoy less crowded trails and a peaceful, authentic off-the-beaten-path cultural experience.
Walk through traditional Tamang villages rich in history, ancient crafts, stone architecture, and hospitality.
Visit ancient Buddhist monasteries, chortens, and Mani walls to learn about deep-rooted local traditions.
Enjoy peaceful trails passing through rhododendron forests, alpine meadows, and lush river valleys.
Enjoy a relaxing dip in the natural thermal hot springs at Tatopani.
Stay with local families in village homestays (especially Briddhim) and savor home-cooked Nepali meals.
Witness vibrant local festivals, traditional clothing, and handmade Tamang textiles.
Meet local mountain farmers and yak herders to hear genuine Himalayan stories.
Perfect for beginners, families, or travelers seeking a short, culturally rich trek near Kathmandu.

treks.title: Langtang Ganja La Pass Trek - 15 Days
treks.location: Langtang National Park & Helambu, Rasuwa / Sindhupalchok, Nepal
treks.activities: High Altitude Trekking & Technical Pass Crossing
treks.accommodation: 3-Star Hotel in Kathmandu / Mountain Teahouses & Tented Camps
treks.meals: Breakfast in Kathmandu, All Meals (Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner) on Trek
treks.overview:
Langtang Ganja La Pass Trek | High Altitude Technical Pass & Himalayan Camping Expedition

The 15-Day Langtang Ganja La Pass Trek is a thrilling high-altitude adventure combining the cultural richness of Langtang Valley with the rugged wilderness of the Helambu region. Starting from Syabrubesi, the trail winds through Tamang villages, pine forests, and alpine pastures to Kyanjin Gompa (3,870 m) before ascending into remote, unpopulated terrain to cross the formidable Ganja La Pass (5,130 m).

Ganja La Pass offers spectacular 360-degree views of Langtang Lirung (7,227 m), Dorje Lakpa, Shishapangma (Tibet), and Ganesh Himal. Descending from the pass into the less-traveled Helambu valley involves camping at high altitude pastures (Ngegang Kharka, Keldang, Dhukpa) managed by a full camping support crew. The trail continues through traditional Sherpa villages including Tarkeghyang and Shermathang before concluding at Melamchi Bazaar.

At Zenex Travels & Tours, we provide comprehensive logistics—including full camping gear, licensed high-altitude guides, camping cooks, porters, Langtang National Park permits, private vehicle transfers, and hotel arrangements—to ensure a safe and unforgettable Himalayan expedition for experienced trekkers.
highlights: Scenic drive from Kathmandu to Syabrubesi through rural hills and Trishuli river valley.
Explore Langtang Valley, rich in Tamang Buddhist culture, Mani walls, and alpine landscapes.
Visit Kyanjin Gompa (3,870 m) and Yala Cheese Factory surrounded by snow-capped Himalayan peaks.
Hike to Kyanjin Ri (4,773 m) or Tserko Ri (4,985 m) for sunrise views over Langtang Lirung Glacier.
Cross Ganja La Pass (5,130 m)—a challenging and remote technical mountain pass.
Experience wild alpine camping at High Camp (4,960 m) and isolated yak pastures at Keldang.
Authentic cultural immersion in traditional Sherpa & Hyolmo villages of Tarkeghyang and Shermathang.
Diverse landscapes—from lush rhododendron forests to rugged glacial moraines and high plateaus.
Stunning panoramas of Langtang Lirung, Dorje Lakpa, Ganesh Himal, and Shishapangma.
Off-the-beaten-path trails offering peace, solitude, and fewer crowds compared to Everest or Annapurna.
End the trek in Helambu with a descent to Melamchi Bazaar and return drive to Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu
itinerary.highlights: Airport transfer, trip briefing, equipment & climbing gear check.
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) in Kathmandu, our Zenex Travels representative will pick you up in a private vehicle and transfer you to your hotel. After check-in, we hold a pre-trip briefing to verify climbing gear, review the high-pass itinerary, and introduce your guide. Overnight at hotel.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu – Syabrubesi
itinerary.highlights: Scenic drive through mountain roads and river valleys to Syabrubesi.
itinerary.description: Drive north from Kathmandu early morning through scenic mountain roads and the town of Dhunche. Arrive in Syabrubesi (1,503 m), nestled along the Trishuli River inside Langtang National Park. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Syabrubesi – Lama Hotel
itinerary.highlights: Cross Bhote Koshi River, walk along Langtang Khola through bamboo forests.
itinerary.description: Begin trekking across the Bhote Koshi River, following the Langtang Khola uphill through oak, rhododendron, and bamboo forests. Lunch at Bamboo (1,960 m) before ascending past Rimche to Lama Hotel (2,480 m). Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Lama Hotel – Langtang Village
itinerary.highlights: Trail through Ghodatabela, waterfalls, Tamang settlements, view of Langtang Lirung.
itinerary.description: Trek through oak and rhododendron forests to Ghodatabela (3,030 m) for lunch. Continue past Thyangsyap and Chayamki to Langtang Village (3,430 m). Witness the inspiring village rebuilding under the shadow of Langtang Lirung. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Langtang – Kyanjin Gompa
itinerary.highlights: Walk past Mani walls & chortens, visit Kyanjin Gompa & Yala Cheese Factory.
itinerary.description: Enjoy a short 3-hour trek winding past Mani walls, prayer flags, and yak pastures to Kyanjin Gompa (3,870 m). Visit the historic Kyanjin Monastery and the famous Yala Cheese Factory established in 1952. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Kyanjin Gompa | Ascend Kyanjin Ri (4,773 m) or Tserko Ri (4,985 m)
itinerary.highlights: Sunrise peak climb to Kyanjin Ri or Tserko Ri, 360-degree glacier panoramas.
itinerary.description: Hike early morning to Kyanjin Ri (4,773 m) for an unforgettable sunrise over Langtang Lirung (7,245 m), Yala Peak, and Dorje Lakpa. Return for breakfast and optional excursion up Tserko Ri (4,985 m) for acclimatization before tomorrow's climb. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Kyanjin Gompa – High Camp
itinerary.highlights: Climb past yak pastures & glacial streams into remote alpine terrain at High Camp.
itinerary.description: Ascend eastward from Kyanjin Gompa into remote alpine terrain above Langtang Valley. Cross rocky ridges, glacial streams, and loose scree to reach Ganja La High Camp (4,960 m). Set up camp under mountain slopes in preparation for crossing Ganja La Pass. Overnight at tented camp.

itinerary.title: High Camp – Ganja La Pass (5,130 m) – Keldang
itinerary.highlights: Cross Ganja La Pass (5130m), technical descent over snowfields to Keldang pastures.
itinerary.description: Start before sunrise for the steep push to Ganja La Pass (5,130 m). Cross snowfields and rocky ridges (using ropes/crampons if required) to reach the prayer-flag-strewn pass. Marvel at 360-degree views of Langtang Lirung, Dorje Lakpa, and Shishapangma. Descend steep, technical moraine slopes down to Keldang (4,270 m) yak pastures. Overnight at tented camp.

itinerary.title: Keldang – Dhukpa
itinerary.highlights: Descend wide alpine valley, cross glacial streams to Dhukpa yak pastures.
itinerary.description: Trek gently downhill across wide alpine valleys, crossing glacial streams and grassy pastures surrounded by dramatic mountain walls. Arrive at Dhukpa (4,040 m), a tranquil yak-grazing sanctuary. Overnight at tented camp.

itinerary.title: Dhukpa – Tarkeghyang
itinerary.highlights: Descend into rhododendron forests, arrive in historic Hyolmo village of Tarkeghyang.
itinerary.description: Descend from alpine pastures into lush rhododendron, pine, and oak forests. Enter the Helambu region and reach Tarkeghyang (2,600 m), an ancient Hyolmo village famous for stone houses, Buddhist monasteries, and local culture. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Tarkeghyang – Shermathang
itinerary.highlights: Easy walk past Mani walls, chortens & apple orchards of Shermathang.
itinerary.description: Enjoy a comfortable flat walk through pine forests, passing Mani walls, chortens, and traditional Sherpa settlements. Arrive in Shermathang (2,590 m), offering views of Jugal and Ganesh Himal ranges and local apple orchards. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Shermathang – Melamchi Bazaar
itinerary.highlights: Final downhill walk through terraced farmlands to Melamchi Bazaar.
itinerary.description: Trek downhill through terraced farmlands, Sherpa hamlets, and river valleys, descending to Melamchi Bazaar (870 m). Celebrate the completion of the high pass circuit. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Melamchi Bazaar – Kathmandu
itinerary.highlights: Return drive to Kathmandu, check in hotel and relax.
itinerary.description: After breakfast in Melamchi Bazaar, drive back to Kathmandu in a private vehicle (approx. 3-4 hours). Check into your hotel and spend the rest of the day relaxing or taking a spa treatment. Overnight at hotel.

itinerary.title: Free day in Kathmandu
itinerary.highlights: UNESCO Heritage sightseeing, Thamel shopping, official farewell dinner.
itinerary.description: Free day in Kathmandu for shopping, resting, or visiting UNESCO World Heritage sites (Swoyambhunath, Boudhanath, Pashupatinath). In the evening, join your guide for a traditional farewell dinner hosted by Zenex Travels & Tours. Overnight at hotel.

treks.difficultyInfo: Trekking to Langtang Ganja La Pass is graded HARD, suitable for experienced and physically fit trekkers. The trek reaches a maximum altitude of 5,130 meters at Ganja La Pass. The crossing involves steep ascents, loose scree, glacier traverses, and possible snow/ice conditions requiring crampons and ropes. After Kyanjin Gompa, the trail is unpopulated and requires full camping gear and logistics support.

altitudeSickness.description: With a high point of 5,130 meters at Ganja La Pass, altitude sickness is a key risk. Gradual acclimatization in Langtang and Kyanjin Gompa is built into the 15-day itinerary.
prevention: Maintain a steady pace during the climb to Kyanjin Gompa and High Camp.
Ascend Kyanjin Ri (4,773 m) or Tserko Ri (4,985 m) for acclimatization before pass day.
Drink 3-4 liters of clean water daily to stay hydrated.
Avoid alcohol, smoking, and notify your Zenex Travels guide immediately if feeling unwell.

faqs.question: Where is the Langtang Ganja La Pass Trek located?
faqs.answer: The trek is located in the Langtang region of Nepal inside Langtang National Park, connecting Langtang Valley to the Helambu region via Ganja La Pass.

faqs.question: What is the maximum altitude of the Ganja La Pass Trek?
faqs.answer: The highest elevation is Ganja La Pass at 5,130 meters (16,830 ft).

faqs.question: How difficult is the Langtang Ganja La Pass Trek?
faqs.answer: It is rated HARD. It requires crossing a 5,130 m technical pass over loose scree and snow, multi-day wilderness camping, and 6-7 hours of daily walking.

faqs.question: What is the best time for Ganja La Pass Trek?
faqs.answer: Spring (late March to May) and Autumn (October to early November) offer stable weather, clear skies, and safer pass conditions.

faqs.question: What permits are required for Ganja La Pass Trek?
faqs.answer: Langtang National Park Entry Permit is required. Zenex Travels & Tours handles all permit logistics.

faqs.question: Is camping required on the Ganja La Pass Trek?
faqs.answer: Yes, between Kyanjin Gompa and Tarkeghyang there are no teahouses, requiring 3 nights of wild tented camping.

faqs.question: Is a guide and support crew mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes, a licensed high-altitude guide, camping cook, and porters are mandatory for safety and camping logistics on Ganja La Pass.

faqs.question: What equipment is provided by Zenex Travels?
faqs.answer: We provide 2-person sleeping tents, dining tent, kitchen tent, toilet tent, mattresses, cooking gear, and duffel bags.

faqs.question: What mountains can you see from Ganja La Pass?
faqs.answer: Panoramas include Langtang Lirung (7,227 m), Dorje Lakpa, Ganesh Himal, Yala Peak, and Shishapangma in Tibet.

faqs.question: Is technical climbing gear needed for Ganja La Pass?
faqs.answer: Depending on snow conditions, crampons, ice axes, or fixed ropes may be used on the steep pass sections.

faqs.question: Is this trek suitable for beginners?
faqs.answer: No, this trek is recommended only for experienced trekkers with prior multi-day high altitude experience.

faqs.question: Can the 15-day Ganja La Pass itinerary be customized?
faqs.answer: Yes! Zenex Travels & Tours can adjust acclimatization days, camping arrangements, and private vehicle transport.

treks.location: Upper Mustang & Lo Manthang, Mustang District, Nepal
treks.activities: 4WD Jeep Overland Tour, Cultural Exploration & Cave Visits
treks.accommodation: Hotels in Kathmandu & Pokhara / Mountain Lodges & Teahouses

treks.overview:
Upper Mustang Drive-In Drive-Out 4WD Jeep Tour | Explore Mustang's Ancient Culture & Himalayan Desert Landscapes

The 13-Day Upper Mustang Tour from Kathmandu is a culturally rich and scenic overland journey to one of Nepal's most remote and fascinating Himalayan regions. Known as the "Last Forbidden Kingdom", Upper Mustang offers a unique blend of ancient Tibetan Buddhist heritage, wind-carved desert canyons, 1,000-year-old cliffside cave dwellings, and sacred monasteries.

Travelers explore the historic walled capital of Lo Manthang, sacred Muktinath Temple, ancient sky caves in Chhoser, and 1,300-year-old Ghar Gompa (Lo-Ghyakar). With 4WD vehicle access throughout the circuit, this tour is suitable for travelers who wish to avoid long trekking walks while fully immersing in Mustang's spiritual and natural beauty. Located in the rain-shadow of the Dhaulagiri and Annapurna ranges, Upper Mustang is also ideal for summer monsoon travel.

At Zenex Travels & Tours, we arrange all logistics—including Special Restricted Area Permits (RAP USD 500), Annapurna Conservation Area Permits (ACAP), private 4WD Mahindra Scorpio / Toyota Land Cruiser vehicles with expert drivers, licensed tour guides, quality lodge bookings, and hotel stays in Kathmandu and Pokhara.
highlights: Explore the Ancient Walled City of Lo Manthang — historic capital of the Mustang Kingdom with rich Tibetan architecture and royal heritage.
Visit sacred Muktinath Temple at 3,800 m altitude, a holy pilgrimage site for both Hindus and Buddhists with 108 stone spouts.
Experience the stunning Mustang rain-shadow desert landscape, featuring dramatic red cliffs, deep canyons, and vast wind-sculpted valleys.
Drive through traditional Mustang villages like Kagbeni, Chele, Geling, Dhakmar, Charang, and Marpha showcasing ancient Tibetan culture.
Discover thousands of ancient man-made sky caves in Chhoser and Jhong carved vertically into desert cliffs.
Witness panoramic views of Dhaulagiri (8,167 m), Annapurna, Nilgiri, Tukuche, and Tibetan plateau peaks.
Visit 1,300-year-old historic Buddhist monasteries including Ghar Gompa (Lo-Ghyakar), Charang Monastery, and Thubchen Gompa.
Relax in natural thermal hot springs at Tatopani along the Kali Gandaki River Valley.
Experience the vibrant 3-day Tiji Festival (seasonal May/June) featuring monk mask dances in Lo Manthang.
Drive along the Kali Gandaki River through the world's deepest gorge in heavy-duty 4WD Jeeps.
Enjoy leisure, sightseeing, and Phewa Lake boating in Pokhara before and after the Mustang expedition.

quickFacts.accommodation: Hotels in Kathmandu & Pokhara / Mountain Lodges & Teahouses
quickFacts.meals: Breakfast in Kathmandu & Pokhara, All Meals (Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner) on Tour

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu
itinerary.highlights: Airport pickup, hotel transfer, pre-trip briefing & tour guide introduction.
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) in Kathmandu, your Zenex Travels representative will pick you up in a private vehicle and transfer you to your hotel. After check-in, we hold a brief pre-trip meeting to review tour permits, answer questions, and introduce your guide. Overnight at hotel.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu UNESCO World Heritage Sightseeing & Tour Preparation
itinerary.highlights: Guided UNESCO tour: Kathmandu Durbar Square, Swayambhunath (Monkey Temple), Boudhanath Stupa & Pashupatinath.
itinerary.description: Spend the day exploring Kathmandu's famous UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Visit ancient palaces at Kathmandu Durbar Square, panoramic views at Swayambhunath Stupa, sacred Hindu rituals along Bagmati River at Pashupatinath, and the giant Buddhist stupa at Boudhanath. Finalize restricted area permits for Upper Mustang. Overnight at hotel.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu – Pokhara
itinerary.highlights: Drive along Trishuli and Marshyangdi rivers to lakeside city of Pokhara.
itinerary.description: Depart Kathmandu after breakfast in a private vehicle for Pokhara (approx. 7 hours drive). Enjoy scenic countryside views along river valleys and terraced farmlands. Check into your hotel in Pokhara and enjoy an evening stroll along Phewa Lake. Overnight at hotel.

itinerary.title: Pokhara – Tatopani
itinerary.highlights: Drive through Beni along Kali Gandaki Valley, relax in natural hot springs at Tatopani.
itinerary.description: Drive from Pokhara past Nayapul, Kushma, and Beni into the Kali Gandaki River Valley. Beyond Beni, the road turns off-road into mountain terrain. Arrive in Tatopani (1,190 m) and spend the afternoon soaking in warm, mineral-rich natural thermal hot springs. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Tatopani – Marpha – Jomsom – Muktinath (3,800 m) – Kagbeni
itinerary.highlights: World's deepest Kali Gandaki Gorge, apple orchards of Marpha, Muktinath Temple & Kagbeni.
itinerary.description: Drive north through the spectacular Kali Gandaki Gorge between Dhaulagiri and Annapurna ranges. Pass permit checkpoint at Ghasa and explore Marpha village, famous for apple orchards and whitewashed Thakali stone houses. Continue to Jomsom and ascend to holy Muktinath Temple (3,800 m) to view 108 sacred water spouts and eternal flame. Descend to Kagbeni (2,800 m), the historic gateway to Upper Mustang. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Kagbeni – Chele – Geling
itinerary.highlights: Enter restricted Upper Mustang, pass Tangbe stone houses, Chhusang cliffs & Chele village.
itinerary.description: Submit restricted area permits at Kagbeni checkpoint and enter Upper Mustang. Drive past traditional stone hamlets of Tangbe and towering red cliffs of Chhusang. Cross the Kali Gandaki River bridge to Chele for lunch. Continue past Samar and Syangbochen pass to Geling (3,570 m) and visit historic Geling Monastery. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Geling – Dhakmar – Lo-Ghyakar Gompa – Charang – Lo Manthang
itinerary.highlights: Longest Mani wall at Ghemi, red cliffs of Dhakmar, 1300-yr Ghar Gompa, Charang Palace & Lo Manthang.
itinerary.description: Drive from Geling past Ghemi village and its famous long Mani wall. Continue to Dhakmar red cliff canyons and visit 1,300-year-old Lo-Ghyakar Gompa (Ghar Gompa, 3,950 m) established by Guru Rinpoche. Stop in historic Charang village to explore Charang Monastery. Arrive in the walled capital of Lo Manthang (3,810 m). Stroll around old courtyards and the Royal Palace. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Lo Manthang Exploration (Monasteries, Royal Palace & Chhoser Sky Caves)
itinerary.highlights: Jampa Gompa, Thubchen Gompa, Chhoede Gompa, Royal Palace & Jhong Sky Cave complex at Chhoser.
itinerary.description: Spend a full day exploring ancient Lo Manthang. Visit 15th-century Jampa Gompa (God House), Thubchen Gompa assembly hall, and active Chhoede Gompa. Take a short 4WD excursion north to Chhoser to explore Jhong Cave—a multi-story cliff dwelling carved thousands of years ago for meditation and refuge. Return to Lo Manthang for evening local interactions. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Lo Manthang – Marpha
itinerary.highlights: Scenic return drive across desert plateaus, Ghami, Kagbeni & Jomsom to Marpha.
itinerary.description: Begin the return drive from Lo Manthang following the Kali Gandaki Valley back down through Upper Mustang. Enjoy changing light over red rock canyons and snow peaks. Pass Kagbeni and Jomsom to reach the tranquil apple village of Marpha (2,650 m). Sample fresh apple cider and bakery items. Overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Marpha – Pokhara
itinerary.highlights: Drive along Kali Gandaki river gorge, Tatopani & Beni back to Pokhara.
itinerary.description: Drive back from Marpha down through Ghasa, Tatopani, and Beni to Pokhara. Upon arrival in Pokhara, check into your hotel. Spend a relaxed evening by Phewa Lake or enjoy dining at Lakeside restaurants. Overnight at hotel.

itinerary.title: Free Day in Pokhara for Sightseeing & Relaxation
itinerary.highlights: Boating on Phewa Lake, Tal Barahi Temple, World Peace Stupa, Davis Fall & Gupteshwor Cave.
itinerary.description: Enjoy a free relaxation day in Pokhara. Options include morning boating on Phewa Lake, visiting Tal Barahi Island Temple, taking a cable car or drive to World Peace Stupa / Pumdikot Shiva Temple for mountain panoramas, or exploring Davis Fall and Gupteshwor Cave. Overnight at hotel.

itinerary.title: Pokhara – Kathmandu
itinerary.highlights: Return drive to Kathmandu, evening official farewell dinner with traditional cultural performance.
itinerary.description: Drive back from Pokhara to Kathmandu in a private vehicle (approx. 7 hours). Check into your hotel and enjoy free time for souvenir shopping in Thamel. In the evening, join your Zenex Travels team for a traditional Nepali farewell dinner. Overnight at hotel.

itinerary.title: Departure from Kathmandu
itinerary.highlights: Airport transfer for international departure flight.
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast at your hotel. At your scheduled flight departure time, your Zenex Travels representative will transfer you by private vehicle to Tribhuvan International Airport for your return flight home.
