faqs.question: How difficult is the Annapurna Circuit Trek with Tilicho Lake?
faqs.answer: It is graded Hard due to high altitude (5,416 m Thorong La Pass, 4,990 m Tilicho Lake), long daily walks (6-8 hours), and landslide-prone trails near Tilicho Base Camp.

faqs.question: What makes Tilicho Lake special?
faqs.answer: At 4,990 meters, Tilicho Lake is one of the highest alpine lakes in the world, surrounded by towering peaks and revered in Hindu mythology as 'The Great Ice Lake'.

faqs.question: Is Thorong La Pass safe to cross?
faqs.answer: Yes, with proper acclimatization and an early 5:00 AM start to avoid strong afternoon winds. Our licensed guide ensures safety every step of the way.

faqs.question: What accommodation is available on the trail?
faqs.answer: Tea house mountain lodges with twin beds and shared bathrooms. Dining halls feature central heating stoves.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu (1350 m)
itinerary.details: Upon arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) in Kathmandu, you will be greeted by our correspondent who will assist with your transfer to the hotel. Once checked in, we will arrange a pre-trip meeting where we will brief in short about the trek, answer any queries you have and meet your trekking guide as well. After the short brief, you can relax and spend rest of the day at your leisure. Stay overnight at hotel.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu – Besisahar (760 m) – Dharapani (1860 m)
itinerary.details: Drive from Kathmandu along the Prithvi Highway to Besisahar, then switch to a private local jeep following the Marsyangdi River past waterfalls, Syange, and Tal village to Dharapani (1,860 m) taking 9-10 hours (220 km). Check permits at entry post. Stay overnight at lodge in Dharapani.

itinerary.title: Dharapani – Chame (2670 m)
itinerary.details: First day of trekking! Walk 6 hours (16 km) through pine and oak forests along Marsyangdi River past Bagarchhap, Danakyu, Timang village, and Koto to Chame (2,670 m), district headquarters of Manang. Views of Lamjung Himal and Annapurna II. Stay overnight at lodge in Chame.

itinerary.title: Chame – Upper Pisang (3300 m)
itinerary.details: Trek 6 hours (15.5 km) through dense pine forests past Bhratang apple orchards (taste fresh apple pie/juice!) and cross suspension bridge to Dhikur Pokhari for lunch. Ascend gently to traditional stone-walled village of Upper Pisang (3,300 m) with views of Annapurna II and Pisang Peak. Stay overnight at lodge in Upper Pisang.

itinerary.title: Upper Pisang – Manang (3540 m)
itinerary.details: Trek 7-8 hours (19 km) via high scenic route past Green Lake to Ghyaru (3,570 m) and Ngawal (3,660 m) for panoramic vistas of Annapurna massif. Visit historic 900-year-old Braga Gompa before reaching vibrant Manang village (3,540 m). Stay overnight at lodge in Manang.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization day in Manang (3540 m)
itinerary.details: Acclimatization day. Take a popular 3-hour hike to Gangapurna Glacier Viewpoint and Lake, visit historic Milarepa Cave (6 hrs), or take an optional challenging day hike to Ice Lake (Kicho Tal, 4,600 m). Enjoy hot shower and bakeries in Manang. Stay overnight at lodge in Manang.

itinerary.title: Manang - Khangsar (3734 m) – Sri Kharka (4080 m)
itinerary.details: Leave main circuit trail and trek 4-5 hours (5.5 km) through dry alpine terrain past traditional Tibetan village of Khangsar (3,734 m) to Sri Kharka (4,080 m). Views of Chulu East & West. Stay overnight at lodge in Sri Kharka.

itinerary.title: Sri Kharka - Tilicho Base Camp (4150 m)
itinerary.details: Trek 3 hours (6 km) along narrow trails crossing landslide scree slopes beneath dramatic cliffs to reach Tilicho Base Camp (4,150 m) at the foot of Tilicho Peak (7,134 m). Rest and prepare for lake excursion. Stay overnight at lodge in Base Camp.

itinerary.title: Tilicho Base Camp – Tilicho Lake (4920 m) – Sri Kharka (4080 m)
itinerary.details: Major highlight! Early 5 AM climb (3-4 hrs) up rocky trails to pristine turquoise Tilicho Lake (4,920 m, 'The Great Ice Lake') beneath Tilicho Peak and Nilgiri Himal. Enjoy breathtaking views and return to Base Camp for lunch, then descend to Sri Kharka (4,080 m) taking 7-8 hours total (16 km). Stay overnight at lodge in Sri Kharka.

itinerary.title: Sri Kharka - Yak Kharka (4050 m)
itinerary.details: Rejoin main Annapurna Circuit route! Trek 4-5 hours (10 km) along high ridges descending to Marsyangdi wooden bridge before ascending past yak grazing pastures to Yak Kharka (4,050 m). Stay overnight at lodge in Yak Kharka.

itinerary.title: Yak Kharka - Thorong Phedi (4525 m)
itinerary.details: Trek 3-4 hours (7 km) ascending past Ledar (4,200 m), cross Marsyangdi River bridge, and walk across landslide section to reach Thorong Phedi (4,525 m) at the foot of Thorong La Pass. Rest early for tomorrow's pass crossing. Stay overnight at lodge in Thorong Phedi.

itinerary.title: Thorong Phedi – Thorong La (5416 m) – Muktinath (3760 m)
itinerary.details: Pinnacle day of the trek! Early 5 AM start climbing 4-5 hours to prayer-flag summit of Thorong La Pass (5,416 m). Marvel at 360° views of Dhaulagiri Range, Mustang Himal, and Nilgiri. Descend 4 hours into Mustang to sacred Muktinath Temple (3,760 m). Stay overnight at lodge in Muktinath.

itinerary.title: Muktinath - Jomsom (2700 m)
itinerary.details: Morning visit to sacred Muktinath Temple and 108 holy spouts. Trek 6-7 hours (18 km) via Lupra village (visit ancient Bonpo monastery) and Thini along Kali Gandaki River bed to Jomsom (2,700 m), headquarters of Mustang. Stay overnight at lodge in Jomsom.

itinerary.title: Jomsom – Pokhara (820 m)
itinerary.details: Morning flight Jomsom to Pokhara (25 mins) or scenic overland drive (6-7 hrs, 158 km) through Marpha apple orchards, Tatopani hot springs, and Kali Gandaki Gorge. Afternoon free by Phewa Lake. Stay overnight at hotel in Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Free day in Pokhara
itinerary.details: Rest day in Pokhara. Explore Davis Fall, Gupteshwor Cave, World Peace Stupa, Pumdikot Shiva Statue, or enjoy Phewa Lake boating and lakeside dining. Stay overnight at hotel in Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Pokhara – Kathmandu (1350 m)
itinerary.details: Return to Kathmandu by tourist bus or private vehicle (7-9 hours, 200 km) or optional domestic flight. Check in to hotel. Stay overnight at Hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Free day in Kathmandu & UNESCO Sightseeing
itinerary.details: Free day in Kathmandu for shopping in Thamel, leisure, or guided UNESCO World Heritage sightseeing (Boudhanath, Pashupatinath, Bhaktapur Durbar Square). Farewell dinner in evening. Stay overnight at Hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Departure from Kathmandu
itinerary.details: Breakfast at hotel before your private airport transfer to Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) for your flight home.

tourTrips.title: Mardi Himal Trek - 10 Days
tourTrips.destination: Mardi Himal Base Camp & Annapurna Region, Nepal
tourTrips.shortDescription: Short and peaceful 10-day Annapurna trek leading up the Mardi ridge to Base Camp (4,450 m) with close-up views of Mount Machhapuchhre.
tourTrips.description:
Mardi Himal Trek of 10 days is a short and scenic journey in Nepal's Annapurna region, perfect for beginners and those looking for a peaceful trail with beautiful mountain views. Starting with a drive from Pokhara to Phedi, the route passes through rhododendron forests, traditional villages, and scenic ridge stops like Pitam Deurali, Forest Camp, and Low Camp.

From High Camp (3,540 m), trekkers enjoy breathtaking sunrise and sunset views over Machhapuchhre (Fishtail), Annapurna South, and Hiunchuli. The final climb along ridge paths leads to Mardi Himal Base Camp (4,450 m), offering 360-degree views over rocky ridges and snow-covered peaks.

Nepal Mardi Himal Trek | Scenic Ridge Trail & Warm Culture

This 10-day package includes 5 days of trekking along the Mardi ridge and 5 days in Kathmandu & Pokhara. It requires no technical climbing skills, making it one of Nepal's best short treks and a top-selling winter trek destination.

Along the way, connect with warm Gurung and Magar village communities in Dhampus and Sidhing, experiencing traditional Himalayan hospitality and culture.

Who Can Do Mardi Himal Trek?

Graded EASY to moderate. Ideal for first-time trekkers, families, couples, and travelers with limited holiday time who want stunning close-up views of Mount Machhapuchhre without strenuous high-pass climbing.
highlights: Enjoy spectacular panoramic views of Machhapuchhre (Fishtail), Annapurna South, Hiunchuli, Gangapurna, and Mardi Himal
Experience a quieter, peaceful trekking route through lush bamboo, oak, and rhododendron forests away from busy main trails
Connect with warm Gurung and Magar communities in traditional mid-hill villages like Dhampus and Sidhing
Ideal for beginners and intermediate trekkers seeking a non-technical short Himalayan trek
Unforgettable sunrise and sunset vistas from High Camp (3,540 m) and Badal Danda ("Cloud Hill")
Reach Mardi Himal Base Camp (4,450 m) for dramatic 360-degree views right under Fishtail Peak

faqs.question: How difficult is the Mardi Himal Trek?
faqs.answer: It is graded Easy to Moderate. Walk 4-6 hours daily on well-defined forest paths and ridge trails reaching a max altitude of 4,450 m at Mardi Himal Base Camp.

faqs.question: Do I need technical climbing experience for Mardi Himal Base Camp?
faqs.answer: No technical climbing or mountaineering experience is required! It is a non-technical trekking trail.

faqs.question: Can Mardi Himal Trek be done in winter?
faqs.answer: Yes! Mardi Himal is one of Nepal's most popular winter treks, offering snowy landscapes and crystal-clear views of Fishtail Peak.

faqs.question: What views can I expect from High Camp and Base Camp?
faqs.answer: Close-up 360-degree vistas of Mount Machhapuchhre (Fishtail, 6,993 m), Annapurna South, Hiunchuli, Gangapurna, and Mardi Himal.

itinerary.title: Pokhara – Phedi (1130 m) – Pitam Deurali (2100 m)
itinerary.details: Morning drive 1.5 hours from Pokhara to Phedi (1,130 m). Begin 5-hour trek (9 km) ascending through traditional Gurung village of Dhampus (1,750 m) with views of Fishtail and Annapurna South. Walk through rhododendron and oak forests to Pitam Deurali (2,100 m). Stay overnight at lodge in Deurali.

itinerary.title: Pitam Deurali - Forest Camp (2520 m) - Low Camp (2970 m)
itinerary.details: Divert off main trail onto quiet Mardi ridge. Trek 4 hours through oak, maple, and rhododendron forest to Forest Camp (Kokar, 2,520 m) for lunch. Continue 2 hours ascending to Low Camp (2,970 m) for back-side views of Fishtail Peak. Stay overnight at lodge in Low Camp.

itinerary.title: Low Camp – High Camp (3540 m)
itinerary.details: Trek 6 hours (4.4 km) ascending through open alpine terrain past Badal Danda ('Cloud Hill', 2,970 m) for lunch. Walk along narrow ridge trails to High Camp (3,540 m). Enjoy sunset views over Machhapuchhre, Annapurna South, and Hiunchuli. Stay overnight at lodge in High Camp.

itinerary.title: High Camp – Mardi Himal BC (4450 m) – Badal Danda (2970 m)
itinerary.details: Pinnacle day! Early 4 AM hike (3 hrs, 5.3 km) along ridge paths to Mardi Himal Base Camp (4,450 m) for golden sunrise vistas over Machhapuchhre (Fishtail), Annapurna I, and South. Return to High Camp for lunch and descend to Badal Danda (2,970 m). Stay overnight at lodge in Badal Danda.

itinerary.title: Badal Danda – Sidhing (1700 m) – Pokhara (820 m)
itinerary.details: Descend 5-6 hours (8 km) through Low Camp into dense forests down to traditional Gurung village of Sidhing (1,700 m) for lunch. Drive 2.5 hours by private jeep back to Pokhara. Stay overnight at hotel in Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Free day in Pokhara
itinerary.details: Free day in Pokhara to visit Phewa Lake, Tal Barahi Temple, Davis Fall, Gupteshwor Cave, World Peace Stupa, Pumdikot Shiva Statue, or enjoy lakeside cafes and spa treatments. Stay overnight at hotel in Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Pokhara – Kathmandu (1350 m)

tourTrips.title: Ghalegaun Cultural Village Tour with Chitwan - 10 Days
tourTrips.destination: Ghalegaun, Bhujung, Pokhara & Chitwan National Park, Nepal
tourTrips.shortDescription: Charming 10-day cultural village homestay trek in Lamjung Gurung villages (Ghalegaun & Bhujung) combined with a 4-star Chitwan National Park wildlife safari.
tourTrips.description:
Ghale Gaun Cultural Village Trek combined with Chitwan Tour of 10 days in Nepal offers a beautiful mix of mountain village culture and lowland wildlife safari adventure. This trip takes you to the peaceful hills of Lamjung in the Annapurna region to explore traditional Gurung villages, followed by a wildlife safari in Chitwan National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

Known as "Asia’s Model Tourism Village", Ghalegaun (2,050 m) welcomes guests with traditional hospitality following the Nepali belief that "Atithi Devo Bhava" (The Guest is God). Trekkers stay in authentic community homestays in Ghalegaun, Bhujung, Pasgaun, and Pakhurikot.

Gurung Heritage & Himalayan Mountain Panoramas

Enjoy breathtaking panoramas of Lamjung Himal, Annapurna II, III, IV, Machhapuchhre (Fishtail), and Mount Manaslu. Explore Bhujung Village, one of Nepal's largest stone-paved Gurung settlements, famous for traditional honey-hunting cliff practices and cultural folk dances.

Chitwan National Park Wildlife Safari

After completing the hill trek in Pokhara, travel to Chitwan for a 4-star full-board jungle safari package. Activities include 4x4 Jeep Safaris, canoeing along Rapti River, Tharu cultural stick dance, crocodile conservation center visits, and wildlife spotting (one-horned rhinos, Bengal tigers, and sloth bears).

Who Is This Suitable For?

Graded EASY (max altitude 2,150 m). Ideal for families, senior travelers, photographers, culture enthusiasts, and first-time visitors seeking low-altitude hill walks combined with luxury wildlife safari.

faqs.answer: Yes! Because of its low altitude (max 2,150 m), Ghalegaun & Chitwan is one of Nepal's best year-round and winter tour packages.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu (1350 m)
itinerary.details: Upon arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) in Kathmandu, you will be greeted by our correspondent who will assist with your transfer to the hotel. Pre-trip briefing meeting with your guide. Relax for the rest of the day. Stay overnight at hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu – Besisahar (760 m) – Ghalegaun (2050 m)
itinerary.details: Morning drive 5-6 hours to Besisahar, headquarters of Lamjung district. Continue 2-hour mountain drive to Ghalegaun (2,050 m), Asia's Model Tourism Village. Traditional welcome ceremony with Tika and flower garlands. Evening Gurung cultural program and folk dance. Stay overnight at community homestay in Ghalegaun.

itinerary.title: Ghalegaun - Ghanpokhara (2150 m) – Bhujung (1625 m)
itinerary.details: Sunrise view from Ghalegaun View Tower over Mount Manaslu, Lamjung Himal, and Annapurna range. Hike 1 hour to Ghanpokhara village (2,150 m) for lunch. Descend 3-4 hours to Bhujung (1,625 m), one of Nepal's largest stone-paved Gurung settlements famous for cliff honey hunting traditions. Stay overnight at homestay in Bhujung.

itinerary.title: Bhujung – Pasgaun (1700 m)
itinerary.details: Trek 6-7 hours from Bhujung through dense rhododendron forests, terraced farmlands, and scenic hillside trails to Pasgaun (1,700 m), an authentic quiet Gurung village preserving traditional mountain lifestyle. Stay overnight at homestay in Pasgaun.

itinerary.title: Pasgaun – Pakhurikot (1350 m)
itinerary.details: Trek 5-6 hours descending through cultivated terraced fields, lush forests, and peaceful rural settlements to Pakhurikot village (1,350 m). Enjoy homemade organic meals and quiet country atmosphere. Stay overnight at homestay in Pakhurikot.

itinerary.title: Pakhurikot – Pokhara (820 m)
itinerary.details: Final morning walking path. Private vehicle drive 2-3 hours from Pakhurikot to Pokhara lake city. Afternoon free to relax along Phewa Lake lakeside cafes, enjoy boating, or visit World Peace Stupa. Stay overnight at hotel in Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Pokhara – Chitwan National Park
itinerary.details: Drive 5-6 hours (145 km) from Pokhara descending into the tropical lowlands of Chitwan National Park. Check in to 4-star resort. Afternoon Tharu ethnic village walk, Tharu Cultural Museum visit, or jungle orientation walk. Evening wildlife slide presentation. Stay overnight at 4-star hotel in Chitwan.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Jungle Activities in Chitwan National Park
itinerary.details: Full day safari! Morning 3-4 hour 4x4 Jeep Safari to spot one-horned rhinos, deer, sloth bears, and Royal Bengal Tigers. Visit Gharial Crocodile Conservation Breeding Center. Afternoon Rapti River canoeing and birdwatching. Evening Tharu Cultural Stick Dance performance. Stay overnight at 4-star hotel in Chitwan.

itinerary.title: Chitwan - Kathmandu
itinerary.details: After breakfast, depart Chitwan by private vehicle or tourist bus (5-6 hours, 170 km) driving along Prithvi Highway back to Kathmandu. Check in to hotel. Free evening in Thamel for souvenir shopping. Stay overnight at hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Departure & fly towards your destination
itinerary.details: Enjoy breakfast at your hotel before your private airport transfer to Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) for your departure flight.

tourTrips.title: Ghorepani Poonhill Trek with Chitwan - 12 Days
tourTrips.destination: Ghorepani, Poon Hill (3,200 m), Ghandruk, Pokhara & Chitwan National Park, Nepal
tourTrips.shortDescription: The ultimate 12-day Nepal adventure combining the famous Poon Hill sunrise trek (3,200 m) and Ghandruk village with a Chitwan National Park wildlife safari.
tourTrips.description:
The Ghorepani - Poonhill Trek with Chitwan Tour of 12 days is a perfect blend of Himalayan trekking and jungle safari adventure, showcasing Nepal’s natural and cultural diversity. Starting from Pokhara, the trek passes through lush rhododendron forests and traditional Magar-Gurung villages, culminating in one of Nepal's most famous mountain viewpoints: Poon Hill (3,200 m).

Often called the "Small Annapurna Base Camp Trek", this easy-graded trail offers breathtaking sunrise views over Mount Dhaulagiri (8,167 m), Annapurna I (8,091 m), Annapurna South, and Machhapuchhre (Fishtail). After completing the mountain loop in Ghandruk and Pokhara, the tour heads south to Chitwan National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

Poon Hill Sunrise Vistas & Gurung Heritage

Trek through Ulleri, Ghorepani, Tadapani, and Ghandruk. Enjoy panoramic vistas, rhododendron blossoms in spring, and rich cultural interactions with Magar and Gurung communities before relaxing by Pokhara's Phewa Lake.

Chitwan Jungle Safari & Tharu Culture

In Chitwan, enjoy a 3-star full-board safari package including 4x4 Jeep Safari, river canoeing, Tharu village walk, crocodile breeding center visit, and Tharu cultural stick dance performance.

Who Is This Suitable For?

Graded EASY (max altitude 3,200 m). Ideal for beginners, families, couples, and travelers looking for a gentle Himalayan trek combined with exciting wildlife safari experiences!

faqs.question: How difficult is the Ghorepani Poonhill Trek with Chitwan?
faqs.answer: It is graded Easy. Walk 4-5 hours daily on stone steps and forest trails up to 3,200 m (Poon Hill), making it perfect for beginners and families.

faqs.question: What views can I see from Poon Hill?
faqs.answer: Panoramic 360-degree sunrise views over Mount Dhaulagiri (8,167 m), Annapurna I (8,091 m), Annapurna South, Machhapuchhre (Fishtail), Nilgiri, and Himchuli.

faqs.question: What safari activities are included in Chitwan?

faqs.question: Is altitude sickness a concern on this trek?
faqs.answer: The maximum altitude is 3,200 m at Poon Hill, so the risk of AMS is low. Our itinerary is safely paced with gradual elevation gain.

itinerary.title: Pokhara – Birethanti (1025 m) – Ulleri (1960 m)
itinerary.details: Morning drive 2 hours from Pokhara to Birethanti (1,025 m), gateway to Annapurna. Begin 5-hour trek (9 km) ascending stone steps past Tikhedhunga to Ulleri (1,960 m), a scenic Magar village with views of Annapurna South and Himchuli. Stay overnight at lodge in Ulleri.

itinerary.title: Tadapani - Ghandruk (1970 m)

tourTrips.title: Khopra Danda Trek - 14 Days
tourTrips.destination: Khopra Danda (3,660 m), Muldai Viewpoint, Jhinu Danda & Annapurna Region, Nepal
tourTrips.shortDescription: Peaceful 14-day community lodge trek along Khopra Ridge (3,660 m) with Muldai viewpoint panoramas, optional Khayer Lake hike, and Jhinu hot springs.
tourTrips.description:
The Khopra Danda Trek of 14 days is a peaceful and highly rewarding community-based route in Nepal’s Annapurna region, perfect for trekkers seeking a quieter alternative to the popular commercial trails. This trek rewards you with breathtaking views of Mount Dhaulagiri (8,167 m), Annapurna South (7,219 m), Nilgiri, and Machhapuchhre (Fishtail).

What makes this trek truly special is its focus on authentic cultural experiences and community support, with lodges directly run and managed by local villagers. Your stay directly contributes to local schools, healthcare, and infrastructure development in remote mountain communities.

Khopra Ridge (3,660 m), Muldai Viewpoint & Khayer Lake

Trek through rhododendron and oak forests to Khopra Danda (3,660 m) for spectacular sunrise and sunset vistas. Take an optional excursion to sacred Khayer Lake (4,650 m), revered in Hindu tradition. Visit Muldai Viewpoint (3,637 m) for a breathtaking 360-degree Himalayan panorama before descending to the natural thermal hot springs at Jhinu Danda.

Who Can Do Khopra Danda Trek?

Graded EASY to Moderate. Suitable for beginner and intermediate trekkers with good fitness. Ideal for nature lovers, photographers, and travelers seeking offbeat trails and community-based sustainable tourism!

itinerary.title: Swanta – Khopra Danda (3660 m)

tourTrips.title: Short Nar Phu Valley Trek - 12 Days
tourTrips.destination: Nar & Phu Valleys, Kang La Pass (5,306 m) & Annapurna Region, Nepal
tourTrips.shortDescription: Off-the-beaten-path 12-day restricted area trek into the medieval Tibetan lost valleys of Nar and Phu, crossing high Kang La Pass (5,306 m).
tourTrips.description:
Short Nar Phu Valley Trek of 12 days in Nepal is a remote, restricted, and culturally rich journey into the lost valleys of the northern Annapurna region. Opened to trekkers only in 2003, this off-the-beaten-path trail takes you into hidden Tibetan-influenced valleys filled with ancient stone villages, fortresses, and medieval monasteries untouched by modern development.

The trek starts from Koto (2,600 m) where you leave the main Annapurna Circuit to enter the restricted Nar and Phu valleys. Highlights include Phu Gaun (4,080 m), home to the centuries-old Tashi Lhakhang Monastery blessed by the Dalai Lama, and Nar Village (4,200 m).

Kang La Pass (5,306 m) & Hidden Himalayan Vistas

The ultimate adventure of the trek is crossing Kang La Pass (5,306 m), offering jaw-dropping views of Annapurna II (7,937 m), Himlung Himal (7,126 m), Tilicho Peak, Gangapurna, and Pisang Peak before descending to Ngawal on the Annapurna Circuit.

Permits & Restricted Area Regulations

Nar Phu is a Special Restricted Area requiring a Special Restricted Area Permit (min. 2 trekkers accompanied by a licensed guide). All permits are arranged by Zenex Travels!

Who Can Do Nar Phu Valley Trek?

Graded MODERATE (3/4). Suitable for physically fit trekkers and culture lovers looking for remote, peaceful high-altitude Himalayan wilderness away from crowded trails.

Cross the thrilling high mountain Kang La Pass (5,306 m) with vistas of Annapurna II, Tilicho Peak, and Himlung Himal

Visit Tashi Lhakhang Monastery in Phu Gaun, an ancient Buddhist pilgrimage site blessed by the Dalai Lama

Experience authentic Tibetan Buddhist traditions, yak-herding lifestyles, and carpet weaving culture

essentialInfo.title: Permits Required for Nar Phu Restricted Area Trek
essentialInfo.content:
Due to its sensitive border location near Tibet, Nar Phu requires three permits:

• Nar Phu Special Restricted Area Permit: USD 100/week (Sept–Nov) or USD 75/week (Dec–Aug)
• Annapurna Conservation Area Permit (ACAP): NPR 3,000 per person
• TIMS Permit

Must be organized by a licensed agency with a minimum group size of 2 trekkers!

essentialInfo.title: Best Seasons for Nar Phu Valley Trek
essentialInfo.content:
• Spring (March – May): Blooming rhododendrons in lower valleys, mild temperatures, clear blue skies.
• Autumn (September – November): Crisp clear mountain air, stable dry weather, perfect for crossing Kang La Pass (5,306 m).

essentialInfo.title: Teahouse Lodges in Remote Valleys
essentialInfo.content: Accommodations in Meta, Kyang, Phu Gaun, and Nar are authentic, simple teahouse lodges run by local Tibetan-descended villagers. Rooms are twin-share with warm blankets and shared bathrooms.

faqs.question: Why is Nar Phu Valley a restricted area?
faqs.answer: Nar Phu is a sensitive border area near Tibet that was opened in 2003 to preserve its unique ancient Tibetan culture, medieval stone villages, and delicate alpine ecology.

faqs.question: Can I trek Nar Phu solo?
faqs.answer: No. Government regulations strictly require a minimum of 2 trekkers accompanied by a licensed Nepal trekking guide.

faqs.question: How difficult is Kang La Pass (5,306 m)?
faqs.answer: Kang La Pass is a high mountain pass with a steep 5-6 hour ascent from Nar and a 3-hour descent to Ngawal. It requires good stamina and acclimatization.

faqs.question: What monasteries can be visited?
faqs.answer: Tashi Lhakhang Monastery in Phu (blessed by the Dalai Lama) and four ancient gompas in Nar village (Guru Choling, Samten Pelgye Ling, Kunsei Dechen, and Samdru Choling).

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu (1350 m)
itinerary.details: Upon arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) in Kathmandu, you will be greeted by our correspondent who will assist with your transfer to the hotel. Pre-trip briefing meeting with guide. Relax for the day. Stay overnight at hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Permit Preparation & Free Day in Kathmandu
itinerary.details: Reserve day in Kathmandu while our office processes your Special Restricted Area Permit. Enjoy optional guided UNESCO World Heritage sightseeing (Patan Durbar Square, Boudhanath Stupa, Pashupatinath Temple) or an Everest Mountain Flight. Stay overnight at hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu – Besisahar – Koto (2600 m)
itinerary.details: Drive from Kathmandu to Besisahar, then switch to a local private jeep following the Marsyangdi River past waterfalls, Syange, and Tal village to Koto (2,600 m) taking 9 hours total (235 km). Views of Lamjung Himal and Annapurna II. Stay overnight at lodge in Koto.

itinerary.title: Koto – Meta (3560 m)
itinerary.details: Register restricted permit at Koto checkpost. Enter the narrow Soti Khola gorge, cross suspension bridges over Phu Khola, pass Chhongche caves, and ascend through pine forests past Dharmasala to Meta (3,560 m) taking 6-7 hours (17 km). Vistas of Annapurna II and Himlung Himal. Stay overnight at lodge in Meta.

itinerary.title: Meta - Kyang (3887 m)
itinerary.details: Trek 5-6 hours (10 km) through high-altitude desert landscapes, eroded cliffs, and wide riverbeds along Phu Khola past historic Khampa settlements to Kyang (3,887 m). Views of Pisang Peak and Kangaru Himal. Stay overnight at lodge in Kyang.

itinerary.title: Kyang - Phu Gaun (4080 m)
itinerary.details: Trek 3-4 hours (9 km) ascending rugged canyon trails past mani walls and chortens to carved wooden gate of Phu Gaun (4,080 m). Spot blue sheep along cliffs. Explore historic Tashi Lhakhang Monastery blessed by the Dalai Lama. Stay overnight at lodge in Phu.

itinerary.title: Phu Gaun - Nar Phedi (3490 m)
itinerary.details: Descend downhill from Phu, cross Phu Khola bridge, and trek 6-7 hours (14 km) back past Kyang and Upper Chyako to Nar Phedi Monastery (3,490 m). Experience evening Buddhist chanting rituals with local monks. Stay overnight at lodge in Nar Phedi.

itinerary.title: Nar Phedi - Nar Village (4200 m)
itinerary.details: Hike 3 hours (6 km) uphill through barren landscapes, yak pastures, and chortens to Nar Village (4,200 m). Explore four ancient gompas (Guru Choling, Samten Pelgye Ling, Kunsei Dechen, and Samdru Choling) and observe Tibetan carpet weaving. Stay overnight at lodge in Nar.

itinerary.title: Nar – Kang La Pass (5306 m) – Ngawal (3660 m)
itinerary.details: Early morning 4 AM start! Trek 5-6 hours ascending past Jhombu Kharka to prayer-flag summit of Kang La Pass (5,306 m). Marvel at views of Tilicho Peak, Annapurna II, Lamjung Himal, and Gangapurna. Descend 3 hours into Annapurna Circuit to Ngawal (3,660 m) taking 9 hours total (17 km). Stay overnight at lodge in Ngawal.

itinerary.title: Ngawal – Chame (2670 m)
itinerary.details: Rejoin main Annapurna Circuit! Descend 7-8 hours (16 km) through Ghyaru, Braga, Dhikur Pokhari, and Lower Pisang back to Chame (2,670 m). Relax in Chame riverside hot springs. Stay overnight at lodge in Chame.

itinerary.title: Chame – Besisahar – Kathmandu (1350 m)
itinerary.details: Private jeep drive 5 hours from Chame to Besisahar, then continue drive 5-6 hours back to Kathmandu (240 km total). Check in to hotel. Free evening in Thamel. Stay overnight at Hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Departure from Kathmandu
itinerary.details: Breakfast at hotel before private airport transfer to Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) for your departure flight.

tourTrips.title: Namun La Pass Trek - 11 Days
tourTrips.destination: Ghalegaun, Thurju Phat, Namun La Pass (4,910 m), Timang & Dharapani, Nepal
tourTrips.shortDescription: Off-the-beaten-path 11-day wilderness camping trek crossing Namun La Pass (4,910 m) with sacred Dudhpokhari Lake (4,560 m) and Ghalegaun homestay.
tourTrips.description:
The Namun La Pass Trek (Namun Bhanjyang Trek) of 11 days in Nepal is a peaceful, rarely explored camping trek in the Annapurna region. Starting from the traditional Gurung village of Ghalegaun (2,050 m) and ending at Dharapani, this offbeat journey traverses rhododendron forests, alpine meadows, and high mountain ridges.

The crowning highlight of the trek is crossing Namun La Pass (4,910 m / 4,850 m), offering jaw-dropping 360-degree panoramas of Mount Manaslu (8,163 m), Annapurna II & IV, Lamjung Himal, Pisang Peak, Larkya Peak, and Mount Himlung.

Sacred Dudhpokhari Lake (4,560 m) & Wilderness Camping

Trek to Thurju Phat (4,070 m) and spend an exploration day hiking to sacred Dudhpokhari Lake (4,560 m), a high-altitude glacial lake revered by spiritual pilgrims. Enjoy wilderness camping under starry skies supported by our professional camp crew, cook, and staff.

Who Can Do Namun La Pass Trek?

Graded MODERATE (max altitude 4,910 m). Suitable for fit trekkers, wilderness campers, photographers, and culture lovers seeking quiet crowd-free Himalayan trails!
highlights: Cross the spectacular high mountain Namun Bhanjyang / Namun La Pass (4,910 m) with 360° Himalayan panoramas
Experience authentic Gurung cultural homestay and evening traditional welcome show in Ghalegaun (Asia's Model Village)
Full wilderness tented camping trek through remote alpine meadows, pristine ridges, and rhododendron forests
Explore sacred high-altitude Dudhpokhari Lake (4,560 m) nestled beneath the Lamjung and Danfe mountain peaks
Panoramic views of Mount Manaslu (8,163 m), Annapurna II & IV, Lamjung Himal, Pisang Peak, Larkya Peak, and Himlung Himal
Cross Furju Pass (4,385 m) and relax in scenic high-altitude meadow camping grounds at Thurju Phat
Explore traditional Gurung settlements of Timang, Ghalegaun, and Dharapani connecting to the Annapurna Circuit
Spot Himalayan wildlife: deer, snow pigeons, mountain goats, and seasonal yak herds
Enjoy quiet, crowd-free wilderness trails away from commercial tourist routes
Full professional camping crew: licensed guide, cook, kitchen staff, and porters carrying tented gear

essentialInfo.content:

• Autumn (September – November): Crisp clear skies, festival season, brilliant mountain panoramas.

essentialInfo.content: Combines authentic Gurung homestay in Ghalegaun, high-altitude tented camps with full kitchen/dining setup in Rapuraju, Qubar, and Thurju Phat, and teahouse lodges in Timang & Besisahar.

faqs.question: How difficult is the Namun La Pass Trek?
faqs.answer: It is graded Moderate. Walk 5-7 hours daily with a high pass crossing at Namun La (4,910 m). Requires good physical fitness and acclimatization.

faqs.question: Is this a teahouse or camping trek?
faqs.answer: It is a hybrid camping trek! Homestay in Ghalegaun, full wilderness tented camping with professional cook crew at Rapuraju, Qubar, and Thurju Phat, and lodges in Timang.

faqs.question: What is Dudhpokhari Lake?
faqs.answer: Dudhpokhari is a sacred high-altitude alpine lake (4,560 m) located near Thurju Phat, revered by spiritual pilgrims and surrounded by snow-capped peaks.

faqs.question: Can I connect this trek to the Annapurna Circuit?
faqs.answer: Yes! The trek descends to Timang and Dharapani, which directly connect to Chame and the Annapurna Circuit route.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu (1350 m)
itinerary.details: Upon arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) in Kathmandu, you will be greeted by our correspondent who will assist with your transfer to the hotel. Pre-trip briefing meeting with guide. Relax for the day. Stay overnight at hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu - Besisahar (760 m) - Ghalegaun (2050 m)
itinerary.details: Drive 5-6 hours from Kathmandu to Besisahar, headquarters of Lamjung. Switch to local private jeep and drive 2 hours to Ghalegaun (2,050 m). Warm traditional Gurung welcome with garlands and tika. Evening Gurung cultural show by local women community. Stay overnight at homestay in Ghalegaun.

itinerary.title: Ghalegaun – Rapuraju (3150 m)
itinerary.details: Begin camping trek! Walk 5-6 hours (11 km) ascending through blooming rhododendron forests, terraced pastures, and Annapurna Conservation Area trails to Rapuraju (3,150 m). Vistas of surrounding hills and mountains. Stay overnight at Tented Camp in Rapuraju.

itinerary.title: Rapuraju / Maidu Kharka – Qubar (3550 m)
itinerary.details: Trek 6-7 hours (10 km) along high ridge trails towards Qubar (3,550 m). Admire panoramas of Manaslu, Lamjung Himal, Himlung Himal, Annapurna II & IV, and Fishtail from behind. Stay overnight at Tented Camp in Qubar.

itinerary.title: Qubar – Furju Pass (4385 m) – Thurju Phat (4070 m)
itinerary.details: Trek 6-7 hours (13 km) ascending high grassland ridges to Furju Pass (4,385 m) for views of Manaslu and Danfe Himal. Descend 2 hours into wide open alpine meadow camping grounds at Thurju Phat (4,070 m). Stay overnight at Tented Camp in Thurju Phat.

itinerary.title: Rest Day in Thurju Phat & Excursion to Dudhpokhari Lake (4560 m)
itinerary.details: Acclimatization & exploration day! Morning 4-hour ascending hike to sacred alpine Dudhpokhari Lake (4,560 m) beneath Lamjung and Danfe peaks. Explore pristine blue waters, then descend 2 hours back to camp. Stay overnight at Tented Camp in Thurju Phat.

itinerary.title: Thurju Phat – Namun La Pass (4910 m) – Danfe Kharka (3862 m)
itinerary.details: Summit day! Early 4 AM start. Ascend 5 hours uphill to Namun Bhanjyang / Namun La Pass (4,910 m). Enjoy 360° panoramas of Manaslu Range, Pisang Peak, Larkya Peak, Mount Himlung, and Chulu Range. Descend 3 hours (9.5 km total) to Danfe Kharka (3,862 m). Stay overnight at Tented Camp in Danfe Kharka.

itinerary.title: Danfe Kharka – Timang (2650 m)
itinerary.details: Descend 4-5 hours (7 km) down mountain steps and stone trails past yak pastures to Timang (2,650 m), a scenic Gurung village on the Annapurna Circuit route. Stay overnight at lodge in Timang.

itinerary.title: Timang – Dharapani (1860 m) - Besisahar (760 m)
itinerary.details: Trek 4-5 hours (8 km) descending through Gurung villages, terraced fields, and waterfalls to Dharapani (1,860 m). Lunch in Dharapani, then drive 4 hours in local private jeep to Besisahar (760 m). Stay overnight at hotel in Besisahar.

itinerary.title: Besisahar – Kathmandu (1350 m)
itinerary.details: Morning drive 6 hours (175 km) along Marshyangdi and Trishuli Rivers back to Kathmandu. Check in to hotel. Free evening in Thamel. Optional extension to Pokhara or Chitwan. Stay overnight at hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Departure from Kathmandu
itinerary.details: Breakfast at hotel before private airport transfer to Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) for your departure flight.

tourTrips.title: Gurung Heritage Trekking - Camping - 13 Days
tourTrips.destination: Tangting, Karpu Danda (3,072 m), Kwholasothar, Thulek, Gurung Deurali (4,910 m) & Timang, Nepal
tourTrips.shortDescription: Newly explored 2024 cultural wilderness camping trail visiting Kwholasothar ancestral origin village, sacred Dudh Pokhari Lake (4,585 m), and Gurung Deurali (4,910 m).
tourTrips.description:
The Gurung Heritage Trekking Trail (GHTT) of 13 days is a newly opened cultural and wilderness camping route in the Annapurna region of Nepal. Officially explored in 2024 by local Gurung leaders from Lamjung & Pokhara alongside Mr. B.B. Suyal (CEO of Zenex Travels), who praised it as "one of the best, most authentic Himalayan treks ever experienced."

This offbeat trail traverses ancestral migration routes, ancient salt-trade paths, and sacred sites far away from commercial tourist crowds. You will visit Kwholasothar (3,283 m) — the historic origin village from which all Gurung communities migrated across Nepal.

Sacred Dudh Pokhari Lake (4,585 m) & Gurung Deurali Pass (4,910 m)

Trek to high alpine plateaus including Karpu Danda (3,072 m), Thulek (4,070 m), and Thurju. Take a spiritual excursion to sacred Dudh Pokhari Lake (4,585 m) before crossing Gurung Deurali Pass (4,910 m) for breathtaking panoramas of Mount Manaslu (8,163 m), Annapurna II, Annapurna IV, and Lamjung Himal.

Wilderness Camping Experience & Community Support

As a newly opened wilderness route, high-altitude sections feature tented camping setup provided by our professional camp crew, cook, and staff, while lower settlements offer authentic homestays in Tangting and teahouses in Timang.

Who Can Do Gurung Heritage Trekking?

Graded MODERATE (max altitude 4,910 m). Suitable for physically fit trekkers, photographers, culture lovers, and nature enthusiasts seeking an authentic, crowd-free Himalayan expedition!
highlights: Newly opened trail in 2024 explored & promoted by local Lamjung & Pokhara Gurung communities along with Zenex Travels CEO B.B. Suyal
Trek through ancient Gurung ancestral migration paths, salt-trade routes, and sacred high-altitude pilgrimage sites
Visit Kwholasothar (3,283 m), the historical ancestral cradle of all Gurung communities in Nepal with palace ruins
Cross Gurung Deurali Pass (4,910 m) offering 360° panoramas of Annapurna II, Lamjung Himal, Manaslu (8,163 m), and Himalchuli
Excursion to sacred Dudh Pokhari Lake (4,585 m) — a revered pilgrimage site where full-moon bathing fulfills wishes
Experience Thulek (4,070 m) flatlands with mountain vistas, herbal medicinal flora (yarsagumba, wild garlic), and live glacier avalanches
Cultural immersion in traditional Gurung heritage villages of Tangting and Timang with Buddhist monastery visits
Cross Chyangre Deurali (4,539 m) and Furju Deurali (4,393 m) past Kali Lake along ancient high mountain passes
Full wilderness tented camping under starry skies with professional camp crew, cook, and kitchen support
Scenic overland travel to Pokhara lakeside city and drive past Besisahar along Trishuli and Marshyangdi rivers
Support sustainable community-based tourism directly benefiting remote Lamjung mountain villages

faqs.question: When was the Gurung Heritage Trekking Trail explored?
faqs.answer: It was officially explored in 2024 by local Gurung leaders and Zenex Travels CEO Mr. B.B. Suyal as a quiet cultural camping alternative to busy Annapurna routes.

faqs.question: What is Kwholasothar?
faqs.answer: Kwholasothar (3,283 m) is the historic ancestral settlement and ruined palace complex from which all Gurung communities in Nepal originally migrated.

faqs.question: What is the highest point of the trek?
faqs.answer: Gurung Deurali Pass at 4,910 m altitude, offering 360-degree views of Annapurna II, Lamjung Himal, Manaslu (8,163 m), and Himalchuli.

faqs.question: What style of accommodation is used?
faqs.answer: A combination of homestays in Tangting, teahouses in Timang, and full tented wilderness camping with professional cook crew in high-altitude spots like Karpu Danda, Tapro, Kwholasothar, Thulek, and Thurju.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu (1350 m)
itinerary.details: Upon arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) in Kathmandu, you will be greeted by our correspondent who will assist with your transfer to the hotel. Pre-trip briefing meeting with guide. Relax for the day. Stay overnight at hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu - Pokhara (820 m)
itinerary.details: Morning travel by tourist bus (8-9 hours, 200 km) from Kathmandu to Pokhara lake city. Optional 25-minute domestic flight available. Evening free by Phewa Lake. Stay overnight at hotel in Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Pokhara - Tangting (1660 m) – Karpu Danda (3072 m)
itinerary.details: Drive 2.5 hours by private jeep to Tangting (1,660 m), a scenic Gurung village with a Buddhist monastery. Trek 6-7 hours ascending past Chaya to Karpu Danda viewpoint (3,072 m) for panoramas of Annapurna, Lamjung Himal, and Pokhara valley. Stay overnight at hilltop tents / cottage in Karpu Danda.

itinerary.title: Karpu Danda - Tapro (3385 m)
itinerary.details: Trek 4-5 hours through dense rhododendron forests and high alpine pastures past Chomro (3,085 m) lunch camp to Tapro (3,385 m). High-altitude vistas and occasional live glacier avalanche sights across the valley. Stay overnight at Tented Camp in Tapro.

itinerary.title: Tapro - Kwholasothar (3283 m)
itinerary.details: Trek 4 hours descending 300 meters through jungle and pastures to Kwholasothar (3,283 m), the historic ancestral origin settlement of the Gurung people of Nepal. Explore ancient palace ruins and cultural heritage. Stay overnight at Tented Camp in Kwholasothar.

itinerary.title: Kwholasothar - Thulek (4070 m)
itinerary.details: Trek 6-7 hours ascending past horse racing grounds (3,540 m) to Thulek (4,070 m), meaning 'biggest flat land'. Close views of Lamjung Himal, herbal medicinal plants (yarsagumba, wild garlic), and water pools. Stay overnight at Tented Camp in Thulek.

itinerary.title: Thulek - Chyangre Deurali (4539 m) - Thurju (4070 m)
itinerary.details: Trek 5-6 hours along high mountain trails crossing Chyangre Deurali (4,539 m) and Furju Deurali (4,393 m) with vistas of Mount Manaslu. Descend narrow north-face trail to ancient salt trade rest site at Thurju (4,070 m) near Kali Lake. Stay overnight at Tented Camp in Thurju.

itinerary.title: Rest Day in Thurju & Excursion to Sacred Dudh Pokhari Lake (4585 m)
itinerary.details: Rest & spiritual exploration day! Ascend 3 hours to sacred alpine Dudh Pokhari Lake (4,585 m) beneath Lamjung Himal. Bathing here during Bhadau Purnima is believed to wash away sins and fulfill wishes. Descend 2 hours back to camp. Stay overnight at Tented Camp in Thurju.

itinerary.title: Thurju – Gurung Deurali (4910 m) – Danfe Kharka (3862 m)
itinerary.details: High pass day! Early start. Trek 4 hours ascending to Gurung Deurali Pass / Namun Bhanjyang (4,910 m). Panoramic vistas of Manaslu Range (8,163 m), Pisang Peak, Larkya Peak, and Himlung Himal. Descend 2.5 hours to Danfe Kharka (3,862 m). Stay overnight at Tented Camp in Danfe Kharka.

itinerary.title: Danfe Kharka – Timang (2620 m)
itinerary.details: Ascend 30 minutes to Danfe Pass (4,280 m), then descend 4 hours through mountain steps and oak forests down to Timang (2,620 m) connecting to the Annapurna Circuit. Stay overnight at lodge in Timang.

itinerary.title: Timang – Besisahar (760 m)
itinerary.details: Trek 2.5 hours to Dharapani or drive 5 hours by private local jeep from Timang down through mountain roads and waterfalls to Besisahar (760 m). Stay overnight at hotel in Besisahar.

itinerary.title: Besisahar - Kathmandu (1350 m)
itinerary.details: Drive 6-7 hours (175 km) along Marshyangdi and Trishuli Rivers back to Kathmandu. Drop off at hotel. Free time for souvenir shopping in Thamel. Stay overnight at hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Departure from Kathmandu
itinerary.details: Breakfast at hotel before private airport transfer to Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) for your departure flight.

tourTrips.title: Annapurna Circuit Short Trek - 14 Days
tourTrips.destination: Manang, Thorong La Pass (5,416 m), Muktinath, Jomsom & Pokhara, Nepal
tourTrips.shortDescription: Essential 14-day Annapurna Circuit experience crossing world-famous Thorong La Pass (5,416 m), visiting sacred Muktinath Temple, and scenic Jomsom flight to Pokhara.
tourTrips.description:
The Short Annapurna Circuit Trek of 14 days from/to Kathmandu is a condensed version of the classic Annapurna journey, ideal for travelers with limited time who wish to conquer the iconic highlights of the Annapurna massif in 8 active trekking days.

The ultimate climax of the trek is crossing Thorong La Pass (5,416 m) — one of the highest trekking passes in the world, offering once-in-a-lifetime vistas of Mount Annapurna I (8,091 m), Mount Dhaulagiri (8,167 m), Mount Manaslu (8,163 m), Tilicho Peak, and the Mustang Range.

Manang Valley & Tibetan Culture

Journey through Chame, Upper Pisang, and Manang (3,540 m). Explore 500-year-old monasteries in Braga, mani walls, Tibetan Buddhist chortens, and take an acclimatization day hike to Gangapurna Lake or Ice Lake (Kicho Tal).

Thorong La Pass (5,416 m), Sacred Muktinath & Jomsom Flight

From Thorong Phedi (4,525 m), summit Thorong La Pass (5,416 m) before descending into Mustang to visit sacred Muktinath Temple (3,760 m) with its 108 holy stone sprouts. Trek down to Jomsom for a scenic 25-minute morning flight over Kali Gandaki Gorge to Pokhara.

Who Can Do Short Annapurna Circuit Trek?

Graded MODERATE. Suitable for physically fit trekkers, determination-minded beginners, and high-altitude mountain enthusiasts!
highlights: Cross Thorong La Pass (5,416 m) – one of the highest trekking passes in the world with panoramas of Mustang & Dhaulagiri ranges
Explore Manang Valley, a dramatic high-altitude desert with rich Tibetan Buddhist culture, ancient gompas, and mani walls
Visit the 500-year-old Bharga Monastery (Braga Gompa) and historic Milarepa Cave in Manang
Acclimatization day in Manang with hikes to Gangapurna Lake, Ice Lake (Kicho Tal), or Gangapurna Glacier
Visit sacred Muktinath Temple (3,760 m), revered by Hindus and Buddhists with 108 stone water sprouts and eternal flame
Trek through traditional Tibetan-Gurung and Thakali villages: Chame, Upper Pisang, Ngawal, Kagbeni, and Lupra
Explore two unique districts of Nepal: high mountain Manang and Mustang valley desert landscape

tourTrips.title: Tilicho Lake and Mesokanta La Pass Trek - 14 Days
tourTrips.destination: Tilicho Lake (4,919 m), Mesokanta High Camp, Mesokanta La Pass (5,330 m), Jomsom & Pokhara, Nepal
tourTrips.shortDescription: Off-the-beaten-path 14-day high alpine adventure visiting Tilicho Lake (4,919 m), 2-night wilderness camping, and crossing Mesokanta La Pass (5,330 m) to Jomsom.
tourTrips.description:
The Tilicho Lake and Mesokanta La Pass Trek of 14 days is a thrilling, off-the-beaten-path high-altitude adventure combining the world-famous Tilicho Lake (4,919 m) with a wilderness crossing of the technical Mesokanta La Pass (5,330 m) directly into Lower Mustang.

Known as an extended camping trek beyond classic Annapurna routes, this journey offers solitude, high alpine challenges, and dramatic Himalayan landscapes. The trek requires 2 nights of tented wilderness camping beyond Tilicho Base Camp where no teahouses exist.

Tilicho Lake (4,919 m) & Mesokanta La Pass (5,330 m)

From Manang, trek via Sri Kharka to Tilicho Base Camp (4,150 m) and ascend to Tilicho Lake (4,919 m), sacred in Hindu and Buddhist traditions as "The Great Ice Lake". Cross Mesokanta La Pass (5,330 m) for breathtaking panoramas of Mount Nilgiri, Tilicho Peak (7,134 m), and Dhaulagiri before descending to Jomsom.

Wilderness Camping & Jomsom Scenic Flight

Supported by our professional camp crew, cook, and staff during high-altitude tented camping. The trek concludes with a scenic 25-minute morning flight from Jomsom to Pokhara lakeside city.

Who Can Do Tilicho Lake & Mesokanta La Pass Trek?

Graded HARD (max altitude 5,330 m). Designed for experienced high-altitude trekkers, physical endurance enthusiasts, and wilderness campers!
highlights: Visit sacred Tilicho Lake (4,919 m) – one of the highest and most stunning alpine lakes in the world
Cross the remote, challenging, and off-the-beaten-path Mesokanta La Pass (5,330 m) into Mustang Valley
Experience 2 nights of high-altitude wilderness tented camping at Tilicho & Mesokanta High Camp under starry Himalayan skies
Explore traditional Tibetan-influenced villages: Dharapani, Chame, Upper Pisang, Manang, and Khangsar
Acclimatization day in Manang Valley with optional day hikes to Gangapurna Lake, Ice Lake, or Milarepa Cave
Jaw-dropping panoramic views of Mount Nilgiri, Tilicho Peak (7,134 m), Gangapurna, and the Annapurna range
Traverse dramatic landslide rock formations, glacial valleys, and high-altitude alpine desert terrain
Full wilderness camping setup beyond Tilicho Base Camp provided by expert guide, cook crew, and porters
Scenic 25-minute morning domestic flight from Jomsom Airport over Kali Gandaki Gorge to Pokhara
Complimentary Kathmandu hotel, airport transfers, farewell dinner, and guided UNESCO World Heritage sightseeing

tourTrips.title: Annapurna Base Camp Trek via Ghorepani - Poonhill
tourTrips.destination: Ghorepani, Poon Hill (3,200 m), Machhapuchhre BC & Annapurna Base Camp (4,130 m), Nepal
tourTrips.shortDescription: Classic 15-day Nepal trek combining Poon Hill 360° sunrise vistas (3,200 m) with the iconic Annapurna Base Camp Sanctuary (4,130 m) and Jhinu hot springs.
tourTrips.description:
The Annapurna Base Camp Trek via Ghorepani and Poon Hill of 15 days is the ultimate classic trek in Nepal, seamlessly combining the world-famous Poon Hill 360° sunrise (3,200 m) with an expedition deep into the high mountain Annapurna Sanctuary (4,130 m).

This scenic trail leads through terraced farmlands, rhododendron forests, and traditional Magar & Gurung mountain settlements, culminating in spectacular close-up views of Mount Annapurna I (8,091 m), Machhapuchhre (Fishtail, 6,993 m), and Hiunchuli (6,441 m).

Poon Hill Sunrise & Annapurna Base Camp Sanctuary

Begin with a trek through Hille and Ghorepani to Poon Hill (3,200 m) for golden sunrise vistas over Mount Dhaulagiri and Annapurna South. Continue through Tadapani and Chhomrong to reach Machhapuchhre Base Camp (3,700 m) and spend a night at Annapurna Base Camp (4,130 m) encircled by giant Himalayan peaks.

Jhinu Danda Hot Springs & Pokhara Leisure

Descend back through Bamboo to Jhinu Danda for a relaxing soak in natural riverside thermal hot springs before returning to Pokhara for a free leisure day along Phewa Lake.

Who Can Do ABC Trek via Ghorepani?

Graded MODERATE. Suitable for beginners with reasonable fitness, families, couples, and trekkers looking for a comprehensive Annapurna experience without extreme technical climbing!

Stay overnight at Annapurna Base Camp surrounded by towering 360-degree mountain walls and glacier ice falls

itinerary.title: Hille - Ghorepani (2860 m)
itinerary.details: Trek 6-7 hours (11 km) ascending stone steps past Tikhedhunga and Ulleri (1,960 m) through dense rhododendron and oak forests past Nangge Thanti to Ghorepani (2,860 m). Stay overnight at lodge in Ghorepani.

itinerary.title: Ghorepani – Poon Hill (3200 m) - Tadapani (2630 m)
itinerary.details: Early 1.5-hour pre-dawn hike to Poon Hill (3,200 m) for 360° sunrise over Dhaulagiri, Annapurna I, South, and Fishtail. Breakfast in Ghorepani, then trek 5 hours (11 km) through rhododendron ridges to Tadapani (2,630 m). Stay overnight at lodge in Tadapani.

itinerary.details: Trek 5-6 hours (8.5 km) descending through forests and ascending to Chhomrong (2,170 m), a scenic Gurung village overlooking the Modi Khola valley with vistas of Annapurna South and Fishtail. Stay overnight at lodge in Chhomrong.

itinerary.title: Chhomrong - Bamboo – Himalaya (2920 m)
itinerary.details: Descend Chhomrong stone steps, cross Chhomrong Khola, and ascend through Sinuwa into dense bamboo and rhododendron forests past Bamboo and Dovan to Himalaya (2,920 m) taking 8 hours (13 km). Stay overnight at lodge in Himalaya.

itinerary.details: Trek 6-7 hours (8.5 km) past Hinko Cave and Deurali to Machhapuchhre Base Camp (MBC, 3,700 m). Continue ascending into the Annapurna Sanctuary to Annapurna Base Camp (4,130 m). Spectacular sunset over Annapurna I south face. Stay overnight at lodge in ABC.

itinerary.title: Annapurna Base Camp - Bamboo (2310 m)
itinerary.details: Golden sunrise over Annapurna massifs! Breakfast at ABC, bid farewell to the sanctuary, and trek 6-7 hours (14 km) descending back down through MBC, Deurali, Dovan, to Bamboo (2,310 m). Stay overnight at lodge in Bamboo.

itinerary.title: Bamboo – Chhomrong – Jhinu Danda (1780 m)
itinerary.details: Trek 4-5 hours (9.5 km) ascending through Sinuwa to Chhomrong, then descend 1 hour to Jhinu Danda (1,780 m). Afternoon relaxation soaking in natural thermal hot springs along Modi Khola. Stay overnight at lodge in Jhinu Danda.

itinerary.title: Jhinu Danda – Pokhara (820 m)
itinerary.details: Trek short distance to Siwai bridge (2 hrs) and drive 2.5 hours by private jeep back to Pokhara (27 km). Check in to hotel. Free evening in Pokhara. Stay overnight at hotel in Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Free Day in Pokhara
itinerary.details: Free day in Pokhara lake city for boating on Phewa Lake, visiting Tal Barahi Temple, World Peace Stupa, Davis Falls, Gupteshwor Cave, Sarangkot cable car, or relaxing in lakeside cafes. Stay overnight at hotel in Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Pokhara – Kathmandu (1350 m)
itinerary.details: Return to Kathmandu by tourist bus or private vehicle (8-9 hours, 200 km) or optional flight. Check in to hotel. Stay overnight at hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Free Day in Kathmandu & UNESCO Sightseeing
itinerary.details: Free day in Kathmandu for shopping in Thamel or guided UNESCO World Heritage sightseeing (Swoyambhunath Monkey Temple, Boudhanath Stupa, Pashupatinath Temple). Farewell dinner. Stay overnight at hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Departure from Kathmandu
itinerary.details: Breakfast at hotel before private airport transfer to Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) for your departure flight.

blogs.title: Ultimate Guide to Renting a 4x4 Jeep in Nepal for Mustang & Manang
blogs.content: Mustang is the crown jewel of Nepal's trans-Himalayan region. The rugged, unpaved off-road conditions require high-clearance, heavy-duty 4x4 vehicles. In this guide, we break down self-drive requirements, costs, best seasons (Spring and Autumn), and route details from Kathmandu/Pokhara up to Jomsom and Muktinath. We highly recommend booking our seasoned drivers who are well-versed in navigating treacherous landslide zones and local terrain hazards.
blogs.author: Zenex Travel Experts

blogs.title: Everest Base Camp Trek Packing List: Essential Gear Checklist
blogs.content: Packing right for Everest Base Camp is the difference between a successful summit hike and an early flight back. From proper thermal layers to worn-in trekking boots, hydration systems, and acute mountain sickness (AMS) medication, we compile the complete packing guide. Note that Lukla flights have a strict weight limit of 15kg (10kg main duffel + 5kg hand bag), so packing light and smart is critical.

blogs.title: Top 7 Adventure Activities to Experience in Pokhara
blogs.content: Pokhara is the adventure capital of Nepal. From paragliding over Phewa lake from Sarangkot hill to zip-lining, ultra-light flights, mountain biking, and white-water rafting, there's an adventure for everyone. Read about our recommended operators, pricing guides, safety tips, and when to catch the clearest mountain views of Mt. Fishtail and the Annapurnas.
